TALK_REFUGEE_Fatima_Cataclysm.dynamic_line:
I was on my way to visit my parents back in Burlington, waiting at a bus station, when the evacuation notices started sounding.  I'd been a little out of touch for a bit and didn't realize how bad the rioting was getting.  When my bus arrived it got repurposed into an evacuation vehicle, and took me here.  I… I didn't used to be very religious, it's just something I was born to, but since this happened I've been thinking a lot more about God, and how grateful I am for His help in surviving.  With things still so difficult, it helps to know He's got some plan for me.

Anyway, mine was the second bus to arrive, and they were just getting some triage and processing stuff set up.  I was put in charge of helping with the wounded, along with Uyen.  Things went a little strange later on… one of the women doing triage and processing had a bit of a hang-up about particular, um, colors of people being allowed into the center.  She claimed to have lost our 'papers', along with a lot of other peoples'.  Thankfully because we'd helped so many we were able to argue that they couldn't leave us out, but there was no space left downstairs by the time we got that sorted, so here we are.

responses.text: [SPEECH] I don't suppose there'd be some kind of reward if I could clear them out of here?

TALK_EVAC_MERCHANT_BEGGARS1.dynamic_line: They're folks that wanted to come down to our shelter, but we're too full and have neither space nor supplies to share. responses.text: I'll see what I can do.

It's a shame that cardboard fellow didn't go too, but he's relatively easy to handle alone.

TALK_EVAC_MERCHANT_BEGGARS2_Reward2.dynamic_line: You didn't do the full job, but we're fair people here.  Here's five merch a head for the folks you found a new home for.

TALK_EVAC_MERCHANT_BEGGARS2_RewardNo.dynamic_line: Did you hit your head?  I already paid you.

responses.text: Didn't that free up some space for the beggars and people stuck upstairs?

TALK_EVAC_MERCHANT_RANCH.dynamic_line: One of the people that got evacuated here was actually on a charter bus taking him back to his ranch, 'til it was commandeered to be an evacuation vehicle and brought him here.  Once the dust shook out we made a deal to get him home and provide him with labor in return for making the ranch into a subsidiary of our dealings here.  It worked out pretty well for everyone, most of the people with skills for that kind of work are already out there.

responses.text: How about five Merch to do it?
How about ten Merch to do it?

TALK_EVAC_MERCHANT_Boris_Mission_1.dynamic_line: Hmm.  Most of the people downstairs aren't willing to come up for things like that.  If you sweeten the pot a bit, we could get a few folks I'm sure.

responses.text: Thanks.  I'll go let him know.

TALK_FREE_MERCHANTS_MERCHANT_DavePermiss.dynamic_line: *rubs his chin.  "It's probably technically a fire hazard, but there's not much to light up there besides what Dave brings.  And a few of the guards are pretty attached to him, so we could maybe send folks up to keep an eye on him and make sure he's doing okay.  That wouldn't interfere with comings and goings, either."  He pauses a moment, looking at his ledger as if it contains answers.  "You know what?  Sure.  If Dave is okay with it, I can talk the others into letting him have rooftop access to build himself a little shelter, as long as he continues to keep it clean up there like he has in here."

TALK_LABGUARD1_DOCMISSION.dynamic_line: I hope those damn things don't come back for us...

TALK_LABGUARD1_DESCRIBE.dynamic_line: Was just another day at work, was about to go on my patrol when someone came over the loudspeaker and announced an emergency evacuation.  'Course, I couldn't leave till we got all the eggheads out, so I was going to my station when I heard gunfire in the halls.  I peeked my head out and... and these things, these black things were tearing everyone up.  I don't know who or what they were, but they were surrounded by shadow, and I saw one of em shrug off a hit from a soldier's M4.  At that point, I knew this was above my paygrade, and I ran like hell, which is how I met up with the rest of the group, and we took shelter down here.

TALK_LABGUARD1_DENY_HELP.dynamic_line: Sorry, I'm not going out there again.  Besides, these "geniuses" are the only way I'm getting out of here, and they couldn't shoot if their life depended upon it.

responses.text: How did you end up here?

TALK_LABGUARD2_DOCMISSION.dynamic_line: We're getting out of here, right?

responses.text: I feel like there's something you're not telling me.

TALK_LABGUARD2_DESCRIBE.dynamic_line: There's not much to say...  We were attacked, I ran, I met these guys, and... and that's that.

responses.text: It's ok, thanks for the information.

TALK_LABGUARD2_PERSUADE_SUCCESS.dynamic_line: W-Well, alright.  You're right, I should tell you...  The things that attacked us... They weren't monsters, they were soldiers, special soldiers.  One of them came right up to me, and... and I could faintly see the outline of powered combat armor...  I-It thrust a blade at me, and, and...

TALK_LABGUARD2_PERSUADE_FAILURE.dynamic_line: I-I'm serious, that's all there is.

responses.text: Heard anything about the outside world?

dynamic_line.yes: Marshal...
dynamic_line.no: Citizen...

responses.text: So what are you doing right now?

TALK_SCIENCE_REP_NEW.dynamic_line: I'm a doctor, one of the several at the outpost.  We were the lucky ones.  Came here right went things started to go wrong, never left.

TALK_SCIENCE_REP_NEW_DOING.dynamic_line: The Old Guard--that's what's left of the feds--drafted me when they arrived a while ago and set me up here to screen any new arrivals for infection risks.  Can't be too paranoid these days.  Sad to have to turn people away, but I like the assignment for the chance to get news about the outside world.

TALK_SCIENCE_REP_NEW_NEWS.dynamic_line: Sightings of unusual living dead or new mutations.  The more we know about what's happening, the closer we can get to a treatment or maybe even a cure.  It's a long shot, but you have hope to survive.

TALK_SCIENCE_REP_WORLD.dynamic_line: This is no classic zombie outbreak.  The dead seem to be getting stronger as the days go on.  Some survivors too, come in here with… adaptations.  Maybe they're related.

TALK_SCIENCE_REP_ASK_TRADE.dynamic_line: We can't.  There's nothing we can spare to sell and I've got no budget to buy from you.  I don't suppose you want to donate?

TALK_SCAVENGER_DOCMISSION.dynamic_line: Oh. Hi there. I hope you aren't planning any trouble...

TALK_DESCRIBE_SUPPLYDROP.dynamic_line: Um, well I just searched these crates, and they were full of medical tools.

responses.text: Please, this equipment could be the key to stopping the zombies.

TALK_DESCRIBE_SUPPLYDROP_CHECK.dynamic_line: Um, like this thing?  Well I just, I just found it, and it might be worth a lot, I can't just give it away...

TALK_DESCRIBE_SUPPLYDROP_PERSUADE_SUCCES.dynamic_line: Wow, could it really do that?  Ok, please take it, and make sure to mention me when you save the world!

TALK_DESCRIBE_SUPPLYDROP_PERSUADE_FAILUR.dynamic_line: Uh, I'd love to help, but I gotta surive out here too you know.

TALK_DESCRIBE_SUPPLYDROP_INTIMIDATE_FAIL.dynamic_line: I-I don't think so, you better leave me alone!

responses.text: What kind of experiments were you doing here?

TALK_TCLSCIENTIST_DESCRIBE.dynamic_line: We were simply conducting a, er, health survey of the workers at this facility.

TALK_TCLSCIENTIST_PERSUADE_SUCCESS.dynamic_line: Oh fine.  We were conducting mutation experiments on the test subjects here in an attempt to unlock the true potential of humanity.  Things didn't always turn out correctly, of course, but our star specimen should still be somewhere upstairs.  He's of no use to me now, obviously, but you may want to watch out for him if you decide to explore the medical wing.

TALK_TCLSCIENTIST_PERSUADE_FAILURE.dynamic_line: Lie about what?  I am simply an innocent practitioner of science!

responses.text: What are you all doing here?
So what will your group do now?
So what will your group do now?

TALK_TCLHSCIENTIST_DOCMISSION.dynamic_line: You look like you're very capable.

responses.text: Do you know where I could find some classified information?

TALK_TCLHSCIENTIST_DESCRIBE.dynamic_line: As far as I know, we are the last survivors of this trans-coast logistics center.  We were attacked during our evacuation, and we have barricaded ourselves here to survive.  I am the head scientist of this facility.

responses.text: Please, this information could be the key to stopping the Cataclysm.
You can give it to me or I'll take it.
How can I earn your trust?
I'll get back to you about it.

TALK_TCLHSCIENTIST_CHECK.dynamic_line: Very direct are we?  Yes, I in fact hold the only copy of the information you are likely looking for.  However, they are not for a stranger's eyes.

TALK_TCLHSCIENTIST_PERSUADE_SUCCESS.dynamic_line: I suppose I can make an exception if it is of such importance.

TALK_TCLHSCIENTIST_INTIMIDATE_SUCCESS.dynamic_line: I have no desire to make an enemy from you, just take it and leave us be, that information is worthless now anyways.

TALK_TCLHSCIENTIST_PERSUADE_FAILURE.dynamic_line: Sorry, I have clear orders and protocols as head scientist, even in these extenuating circumstances.

TALK_TCLHSCIENTIST_INTIMIDATE_FAILURE.dynamic_line: Aggression would be a poor choice of action for you.

responses.text: How long have you been down here?

TALK_TCLHSCIENTIST_STORY.dynamic_line: I am the head scientist of this lab, though that is likely inconsequential now.  I was instructed by the federal government to perform an emergency evacuation of this facility, and I was preparing to evacuate when we came under attack from unknown adversaries.  Our security team tried their best, but alas many are not much more than civilians given a gun, though how these adversaries bested our military contingent I am still unsure.  Regardless, I was able to convene with the people around me, and we fortified this cargo area to survive.

TALK_TCLHSCIENTIST_STORY_2.dynamic_line: At this point, I am unsure.  We have survived so far by the good grace of ending up in the cargo zone, where some opportunistic scavenging has provided us with large supplies of sustenance and some military equipment.

TALK_TCLHSCIENTIST_STORY_3.dynamic_line: We are backed into a corner, and we do not have the ammunition to fight our way out.  Behind us is the dark train network, which stretches for miles and could contain unimaginable horrors, and in front of us is our former facility, now infested by zombies and shoot-on-sight automatons.  It is no great way to live, trapped in a cargo zone, but I believe it is our only choice.

TALK_TCLHSCIENTIST_DESCRIBE_SAFE.dynamic_line: Now that you've eliminated the most dangerous threat, I feel confident in staying down here for the foreseeable future.  This is a well-fortified location after all, and there are likely years worth of supplies still left in this facility.

TALK_TCLHSCIENTIST_DESCRIBE_NOTSAFE.dynamic_line: Well, you have what you wanted, yes?  Those dangerous adversaries are still present, making any attempt at scavenging much riskier and more difficult.  We will likely be stuck down here for the foreseeable future, though at least we should have a large stockpile of supplies close enough that we need not risk deadly confrontation.

Very few of those monsters seem to be able to break through a fence or wall constructed with the stuff.

TALK_ARSONIST_WORLD.dynamic_line: Nothing optimistic, at least.  Had a pal on the road with a ham radio, but she's gone and so is that thing.  Kaput.

TALK_ARSONIST_WORLD_OPTIMISTIC.dynamic_line: Most of the emergency camps have dissolved by now.  The cities are mobbed, the forests crawling with glowing eyes and zombies.  Some insane shit out there, and everyone with a radio seems to feel like documenting their last awful moments.

TALK_ARSONIST_JOIN.dynamic_line: I don't know.  I mean, if you can make yourself useful.  But that's become a real hazy thing nowadays.  It depends who you ask.  The merchant definitely doesn't want me here when I'm not selling, but… some people get away with it.

dynamic_line.no: Ssh.  Some people in here hate… mutations.  This was an accident.

TALK_ARSONIST_TRADING.dynamic_line: I made some nice things with that ammonium nitrate you got me.  Want to trade?

dynamic_line.yes: As if you're one to talk.  Screw You.
dynamic_line.no: Screw You!

responses.text: What do you do around here?

TALK_EXTERMINATOR_WASPS.dynamic_line: Ants, bees, slimes, spiders... I like them.  Wasps though... wasps are fucking everywhere.  The problem with wasps is that at this point I'm just so fed up with stumbling upon them all the time.

TALK_EXTERMINATOR_DO.dynamic_line: I hunt wasps.  I bet I've eliminated half the ones around here, but there's always more out there.

TALK_EXTERMINATOR_SALE.dynamic_line: Sure, just bagged a fresh round of wasps.  You probably want to avoid the meat, but the chitin and such should be useful.

Wasp queens like to hide, but they're deadly if you decide to go knocking on their nest.

responses.text: What do you do around here?

dynamic_line.no: Huh, thought I smelled someone new.  Can I help you?

TALK_EVAC_HUNTER_DO.dynamic_line: I trade food here in exchange for a place to crash and general supplies.  Well, more specifically I trade food that isn't stale chips and flat cola.

TALK_EVAC_HUNTER_LIFE.dynamic_line: Not really, just trying to lead my life.

responses.text: Great, now my mouth is watering…

TALK_EVAC_HUNTER_HUNT.dynamic_line: Yep.  Whatever game I spot, I bag and sell the meat and other parts here.  Got the occasional fish and basket full of wild fruit, but nothing comes close to a freshly-cooked moose steak for supper!

TALK_EVAC_HUNTER_SALE.dynamic_line: Sure, just bagged a fresh batch of meat.  You may want to grill it up before it gets too, uh… 'tender'.

dynamic_line: Feed a man a fish, he's full for a day.  Feed a man a bullet, he's full for the rest of his life.
Spot your prey before something nastier spots you.

The Jabberwock is real, don't listen to what anybody else says.  If you see it, RUN.

Smoke crack to get more shit done.

TALK_OLD_GUARD_REP_NEW.dynamic_line: I'm the region's federal liaison.  Most people here call us the 'Old Guard' and I rather like the sound of it.  Despite how things currently appear, the federal government was not entirely destroyed.  After the outbreak I was chosen to coordinate civilian and militia efforts in support of military operations.

TALK_OLD_GUARD_REP_NEW_DOING.dynamic_line: I ensure that the citizens here have what they need to survive and protect themselves from raiders.  Keeping some form of law is going to be the most important element in rebuilding the world.  We do what we can to keep the 'Free Merchants' here prospering and in return they have provided us with spare men and supplies when they can.

TALK_OLD_GUARD_REP_NEW_DOWNSIDE.dynamic_line: Well… I was like any other civilian till they conscripted me so I'll tell it to you straight.  They're the best hope we got right now.  They are stretched impossibly thin but are willing to do what is needed to maintain order.  They don't care much about looters since they understand most everyone is dead, but if you have something they need… you WILL give it to them.  Since most survivors here have nothing they want, they are welcomed as champions.

TALK_OLD_GUARD_REP_WORLD.dynamic_line: There isn't much pushed out by public relations that I'd actually believe.  From what I gather, communication between the regional force commands is almost non-existent.  What I do know is that the 'Old Guard' is currently based out of the 2nd Fleet and patrols the Atlantic coast trying to provide support to the remaining footholds.

TALK_OLD_GUARD_REP_WORLD_2NDFLEET.dynamic_line: I don't know much about how it formed but it is the armada of military and commercial ships that's floating off the coast.  They have everything from supertankers and carriers to fishing trawlers… even a few NATO ships.  Most civilians are offered a cabin on one of the liners to retire to if they serve as a federal employee for a few years.

TALK_OLD_GUARD_REP_WORLD_FOOTHOLDS.dynamic_line: They may just be propaganda but apparently one or two cities were successful in 'walling themselves off.'  Around here I was told that there were a few places like this one but I couldn't tell you where.

TALK_OLD_GUARD_REP_ASK_JOIN.dynamic_line: You can't actually join unless you go through a recruiter.  We can usually use help though, ask me from time to time if there is any work available.  Completing missions as a contractor is a great way to make a name for yourself among the most powerful men left in the world.

TALK_OLD_GUARD_REP_Refuse_Boris_Mission_.dynamic_line: I'm sorry, but I can't leave my post here, and I just don't have the human resources even for a project like that.

TALK_OLD_GUARD_REP_Accept_Boris_Mission_.dynamic_line: It's your lucky day: I just made contact with a couple volunteers like yourself, and that's exactly the sort of project I can put them to.

You noticed this place has working WI-FI?  Well not the rest of the net works anyways.

responses.text: Actually, I don't think I have time for that, sorry.

TALK_ROBOFAC_MERC_1_GOLD_MISSION.dynamic_line: I can offer you the whole of my payment for every bar or equivalent you bring.  But keep silent about this, it's supposed to be my job.

yes: Still plenty of outlaws in the roads, perhaps you should tend to your job, marshal...
You see anything you want, marshal?
Oh, a U.S. marshal, how quaint.

TALK_ROBOFAC_FREE_MERCHANT_INTERVAL.dynamic_line: Around <interval>, if the caravan doesn't run into trouble.

dynamic_line.yes: I keep to my own business, and you keep to yours, marshal.  Seems like a fair deal?
dynamic_line.no: We have been supplying this lab here with food from a few hunting and farming communities nearby.  The roads are though and dangerous, but it makes good money, and beats scavenging the cities for scraps.

dynamic_line.yes: Hello there.  Nice to see you, <name_g>.
dynamic_line.no: Haven't seen another face in quite a while.  Not a living one, at least.  State your business.  Maybe you got some use for some of this scrap metal?

responses.text: Why stay here of all places?

TALK_NPC_SCRAP_TRADER_STORY.dynamic_line: Well, I held a modest job here as a scrap yard worker.  Business was fair most days, but when <the_cataclysm> hit, I was on a solo shift.  With all the craziness going on in the cities and whatnot, I decided to just stay here for while.  I figure someone might find a use for the leftover metal lying around, so I started selling it to anyone who passed by.

TALK_NPC_SCRAP_TRADER_FORT.dynamic_line: Like I said, I was already here when the dead got pissed off.  This place had some barbed wire, metalworking tools, and plenty of stuff to make weapons out of.  Even the walls are my own making.

TALK_NPC_SCRAP_TRADER_HOME_STAY.dynamic_line: Sure, I'm fine with it.  There's a spare bed over there for anyone who needs it.  Just don't hog it.  Someone else might come along.

responses.text: [5$]  I'll buy some small sheet metal.

dynamic_line: Sure thing.  I've got a few things on hand, sold in batches of 10-piece each.  What'll ya have?

responses.text: [5$]  I'll buy some small sheet metal.

dynamic_line: Anything else you need?
I've got freshly sorted metals in some small containers ready to go.  What do you want?

TALK_SCRAP_TRADER_ASK_INTERVAL.dynamic_line: Nope, although I have a really good claim by the river.  Gonna go fetch them soon, be right back in <interval>.

TALK_RANCH_BARBER.dynamic_line: Can I interest you in a trim?  It'll cost you 6 merch for a haircut or 3 for a beard trim.  I can do color and styling too.

TALK_RANCH_BARBER_JOB.dynamic_line: What?  I'm a barber… I cut hair.  There's demand for cheap cuts and a shave out here.

TALK_RANCH_BARBER_HIRE.dynamic_line: I can't imagine what I'd need your assistance with.

TALK_RANCH_BARBER_CUT.dynamic_line: Stand still while I get my clippers...

responses.text: Let me see what you keep behind the counter.

TALK_RANCH_BARKEEP_JOB.dynamic_line: If it isn't obvious, I oversee the bar here.  The scavengers bring in old world alcohol that we sell for special occasions.  For most that come through here though, the drinks we brew ourselves are the only thing they can afford.

TALK_RANCH_BARKEEP_INFORMATION.dynamic_line: We have a policy of keeping information to ourselves.  Ask the patrons if you want to hear rumors or news.

TALK_RANCH_CONSTRUCTION_1.dynamic_line: My partner is in charge of fortifying this place, you should ask him about what needs to be done.

TALK_RANCH_CONSTRUCTION_2_JOB.dynamic_line: I was among one of the first groups of immigrants sent here to fortify the outpost.  I might have exaggerated my construction skills to get the hell out of the refugee center.  Unless you are a trader there isn't much work there and food was really becoming scarce when I left.

TALK_RANCH_CROP_OVERSEER.dynamic_line: I hope you are here to do business.

TALK_RANCH_CROP_OVERSEER_JOB.dynamic_line: My job is to manage our outpost's agricultural production.  I'm constantly searching for trade partners and investors to increase our capacity.  If you are interested I typically have tasks that I need assistance with.

responses.text: For the right price could I borrow your services?

TALK_RANCH_DOCTOR.dynamic_line: I'm sorry, I don't have time to see you at the moment.

responses.text: I was wondering if you could install a cybernetic implant…
I need help removing an implant…

TALK_RANCH_DOCTOR_BIONICS.dynamic_line: I imagine we might be able to work something out.

responses.text: I'd like to hire your services.

TALK_RANCH_FARMER_1_JOB.dynamic_line: I was sent here to assist in setting-up the farm.  Most of us have no real skills that transfer from before the Cataclysm so things are a bit of trial and error.

TALK_RANCH_FARMER_1_HIRE.dynamic_line: I'm sorry, I don't have anything to trade.  The work program here splits what we produce between the refugee center, the farm, and ourselves.  If you are a skilled laborer then you can trade your time for a bit of extra income on the side.  Not much I can do to assist you as a farmer though.

responses.text: I'd like to hire your services.

TALK_RANCH_FARMER_2_JOB.dynamic_line: I'm just a lucky guy that went from being chased by the undead to the noble life of a dirt farmer.  We get room and board but won't see a share of our labor unless the crop is a success.

TALK_RANCH_FARMER_2_HIRE.dynamic_line: I've got no time for you.  If you want to make a trade or need a job look for the foreman or crop overseer.

responses.text: [MISSION] The merchant at the Refugee Center sent me to get a prospectus from you.
I heard you were setting up an outpost out here.
Hey, are you looking for workers here?  I know a couple people back at the refugee center that might be willing to come.

dynamic_line.yes: Can I help you, marshal?

no.yes: Morning sir, how can I help you?
no.no: Morning ma'am, how can I help you?

TALK_RANCH_FOREMAN_PROSPECTUS.dynamic_line: I was starting to wonder if they were really interested in the project or were just trying to get rid of me.

responses.text: How many refugees are you expecting?

TALK_RANCH_FOREMAN_OUTPOST.dynamic_line: Ya, that representative from the Old Guard asked the two of us to come out here and begin fortifying this place as a refugee camp.  I'm not sure how fast he expects the two of us to get setup but we were assured additional men were coming out here to assist us.

responses.text: Hopefully moving out here was worth it…

TALK_RANCH_FOREMAN_REFUGEES.dynamic_line: Could easily be hundreds as far as I know.  They chose this ranch because of its rather remote location, decent fence, and huge cleared field.  With as much land as we have fenced off we could build a village if we had the materials.  We would have tried to secure a small town or something but the lack of good farmland and number of undead makes it more practical for us to build from scratch.  The refugee center I came from is constantly facing starvation and undead assaults.

TALK_RANCH_FOREMAN_JOB.dynamic_line: I'm the engineer in charge of turning this place into a working camp.  This is going to be an uphill battle, we used most of our initial supplies getting here and boarding up the windows.  I've got a huge list of tasks that need to get done so if you could help us keep supplied I'd appreciate it.  If you have material to drop off you can just back your vehicle into here and dump it on the ground, we'll sort it.

responses.text: I'll tell them that, but they seemed good for a bit of hard labor.

TALK_RANCH_FOREMAN_Nunez.dynamic_line: we're still in early stages of getting set up, but we're not overly flush for hands, that's for sure.  If they're willing to put in a hard day's work, we can get them busy.

dynamic_line: I'm not in charge here, you're looking for someone else...
Keep civil or I'll bring the pain.
Just on watch, move along.

no: Ma'am, you really shouldn't be traveling out there.

responses.text: I could use your medical assistance.

TALK_RANCH_NURSE_JOB.dynamic_line: I was a practicing nurse so I've taken over the medical responsibilities of the outpost till we can locate a physician.

responses.text: What kind of jobs do you have for me?

TALK_RANCH_NURSE_HIRE.dynamic_line: I'm willing to pay a premium for medical supplies that you might be able to scavenge up.  I also have a few miscellaneous jobs from time to time.

responses.text: [80 Merch, 30m] I need you to patch me up.
[200 Merch, 1h] I need you to patch up me and my companions.
On second thought, I should be fine.

dynamic_line.yes: I can take a look at you or your companions if you are injured.  Supplies are in shortage, so unfortunately I'll have to ask you for 200 Merch, or 80 if it's just you.
dynamic_line.no: Come back later, I need to take care of a few things first.

TALK_RANCH_NURSE_AID_DONE.dynamic_line: Hold still then.  It's the best I can do on short notice.

responses.text: Let's see what you've managed to find.

TALK_RANCH_SCAVENGER_1_JOB.dynamic_line: I organize scavenging runs to bring in supplies that we can't produce ourselves.  I try and provide incentives to get migrants to join one of the teams… its dangerous work but keeps our outpost alive.  Selling anything we can't use helps keep us afloat with the traders.  If you wanted to drop off a companion or two to assist in one of the runs, I'd appreciate it.

responses.text: What kind of tasks do you have for me?

TALK_RANCH_SCAVENGER_1_HIRE.dynamic_line: Are you interested in the scavenging runs or one of the other tasks that I might have for you?

TALK_RANCH_SCAVENGER_ASK_RESTOCK.dynamic_line: Nope, current run hasn't returned yet.  Come back in <interval>.  You might find something you like.

TALK_RANCH_SCRAPPER_JOB.dynamic_line: I chop up useless vehicles for spare parts and raw materials.  If we can't use a vehicle immediately we haul it into the ring we are building to surround the outpost.  It provides a measure of defense in the event that we get attacked.

TALK_RANCH_SCRAPPER_HIRE.dynamic_line: I don't personally, the teams we send out to recover the vehicles usually need a hand but can be hard to catch since they spend most of their time outside the outpost.

TALK_RANCH_ILL_1_JOB.dynamic_line: I was just a laborer till they could find me something a bit more permanent but being constantly sick has prevented me from doing much of anything.

TALK_RANCH_ILL_1_HIRE.dynamic_line: I don't know what you could do.  I've tried everything.  Just give me time...

TALK_RANCH_ILL_1_SICK.dynamic_line: I keep getting sick!  At first I thought it was something I ate but now it seems like I can't keep anything down...

responses.text: I'd like to hire your services.

TALK_RANCH_WOODCUTTER_JOB.dynamic_line: I'm one of the migrants that got diverted to this outpost when I arrived at the refugee center.  They said I was big enough to swing an ax so my profession became lumberjack… didn't have any say in it.  If I want to eat then I'll be cutting wood from now till kingdom come.

dynamic_line.yes: The rate is a bit steep but I still have my quotas that I need to fulfill.  The logs will be dropped off in the garage at the entrance to the camp.  I'll need a bit of time before I can deliver another load.  I'll give you 10 logs for 200 Merch, or 100 logs for 1000.
dynamic_line.no: Come back later, I need to take care of a few things first.

TALK_RANCH_WOODCUTTER_2.dynamic_line: Don't have much time to talk.

TALK_RANCH_WOODCUTTER_2_JOB.dynamic_line: I turn the logs that laborers bring in into lumber to expand the outpost.  Maintaining the saw is a chore but breaks the monotony.

TALK_RANCH_WOODCUTTER_2_HIRE.dynamic_line: Bringing in logs is one of the few tasks we can give to the unskilled so I'd be hurting them if I outsourced it.  Ask around though, I'm sure most people could use a hand.

responses.text: Can I do anything for you?

dynamic_line.no: STOP, Put your hands in the air! Ha, startled you didn't I…there is no law anymore...
dynamic_line.yes: Hi there, <name_g>.

responses.text: Why don't you go somewhere else?

responses.text: What kind of stuff was in the evidence lockup?

responses.text: What did you do before the Cataclysm?

responses.text: What did you do before the Cataclysm?

responses.text: What did you do before the Cataclysm?

responses.text: Why don't you go somewhere else?

TALK_NC_FARMER_EXPERTISE.dynamic_line: I grew up on the farm, I don't know much about ghosts and goblins,  but I've spent a lot of time growing food and I work hard.  It's better in the country, cleaner.  Not as dangerous.  I hope.

responses.text: What did you do before the Cataclysm?

responses.text: What did you do before the Cataclysm?

TALK_NC_SURVIVOR_CHEF_STORY1.dynamic_line: I… um… hid.  I was in the kitchen, preparing another masterpiece when I heard glass shattering followed by screaming.  I ran over to the serving window to see what happened, assuming a guest had fallen and broke something.  What I witnessed was the most awful thing I've ever seen.  I'm not even sure I could go over it again.

responses.text: Horrible.  Did you get any pictures yourself?
What did you do before the Cataclysm?

TALK_NC_SURVIVOR_CHEF_STORY2.dynamic_line: Some lunatic covered in a film of goo, black as oil, had fallen through one of the large glass windows. responses.text: What did you do before the Cataclysm?

People were running in the streets, some even had guns so I locked all the doors and blocked the windows with what I could and barricaded myself in here.

responses.text: What did you do before the Cataclysm?

MISSION_CABIN_CHEMIST_GET_analytical_set.name: Find A Basic Analysis Kit
MISSION_CABIN_CHEMIST_GET_analytical_set.description: Obtain a basic laboratory analysis kit for the chemist.

dialogue.describe: I need a basic laboratory analysis kit.
dialogue.offer: I've checked the stock here at this house, and it turns out there's a few pieces of equipment I need.  Firstly, I need a reliable way to take measurements and verify results. dialogue.advice: One of those old labs might have one.
dialogue.accepted: I'll be here when you get back.  Good luck!
dialogue.rejected: Well, someone's got to do it.

dialogue.success_lie: Thanks for trying… I guess.

MISSION_CABIN_CHEMIST_GET_60_chem_muriat.name: Find Some Hydrochloric Acid
MISSION_CABIN_CHEMIST_GET_60_chem_muriat.description: Obtain 15 liters of hydrochloric acid for the chemist.

dialogue.describe: I need 15 liters of hydrochloric acid.
dialogue.offer: The last thing I really need to get going is hydrochloric acid.  It's one of those chemicals that's just perfect for so many things.  An acidifying reagent, and one of the best.  With a large supply of hydrochloric acid, you and I are only a few steps removed from a stable source of antiseptic, fungicide, and even some light explosives!  As the only apparent health authority left, I do have to warn you not to get it on your skin, though.  Find this for me and I'll sell you whatever I can make.
dialogue.advice: You might find large quantities in a warehouse somewhere, but it often got sold as a household cleaner, did you know that?
dialogue.accepted: I'll be here when you get back.  Good luck!
dialogue.rejected: Well, someone's got to do it.
dialogue.inquire: Do you have the hydrochloric acid?
dialogue.success: Wonderful!  I'm sure this will be quite helpful.
dialogue.success_lie: Thanks for trying… I guess.
dialogue.failure: That's unfortunate.  I guess I'll have to find it myself.

dialogue.offer: I'm in a bit of a spot.  I keep a generator around here to power all my scientific equipment. dialogue.advice: I bet the best place to find that much gas is still a gas station.  Bringing it all here is another problem.  You might want one of those big steel drums we used to use to haul off hazardous waste before <the_cataclysm>.
dialogue.accepted: I'll be here when you get back.  Good luck!

I'd do it myself, but I need to look after this place.
dialogue.advice: It should be pretty simple making the deal, but I'd recommend taking a car over there myself.

dialogue.failure: I'll do it myself, then.

dialogue.offer: Turns out that ant meat you got us wasn't actually too bad.  A little tough, sure, but perfectly edible.  The problem now is we need a way of preserving it.  One of those portable charcoal smokers would be really great.  Heck, you might even wanna buy some.
dialogue.advice: Maybe try a farm?  I bet those rural folks were pretty invested in preserving their food.
dialogue.accepted: Thank you.  We'll be sure to compensate your efforts.
dialogue.rejected: Alright, I can understand that.  I guess I'll have to get it myself.
dialogue.inquire: Do you have the charcoal smoker?
dialogue.success: Thank you.  We'll get started right away.
dialogue.success_lie: I can tell you're lying.  I don't see shit.
dialogue.failure: Ah, well.  It's no big deal.

MISSION_ISHERWOOD_BARRY_1.name: Return Barry to Eddie at the dairy.
MISSION_ISHERWOOD_BARRY_1.name_plural: Return Barry to Eddie at the dairy.s

dialogue.describe: I just want to go home.
dialogue.offer: I can't believe you are here, please take me back to the ranch.
dialogue.accepted: Thank you, I thought I was dead.
dialogue.rejected: Please god no!
dialogue.advice: We shouldn't stay here too long, more might show up.
dialogue.success: Thanks, we'll never be able to repay you, Here's a token of my gratitude, I made these suits for my family and always keep a few extra around.
dialogue.success_lie: I don't feel saved…
dialogue.failure: Tell my family that I love them…

MISSION_ISHERWOOD_CARLOS_1.name: Find an anvil or bronze anvil
MISSION_ISHERWOOD_CARLOS_1.name_plural: Find an anvil or bronze anvils

dialogue.describe: I need an anvil to do advanced metal work.
dialogue.offer: I could really use an anvil.
dialogue.accepted: You might be able to find one in a hardware store or similar.
dialogue.rejected: Thanks anyway, we'll find the time to make it ourselves.
dialogue.advice: If you can't find one, you might be able to find the raw steel or try your hand at bronze casting to make one.
dialogue.success: I appreciate it, this will really make a difference, here's some horse armor I've been working on.  Eventually I'll have the whole herd outfitted.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do me?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.describe: Chris hasn't come back from his latest search for Barry, I'm getting concerned.
dialogue.offer: Can you go find my son and tell him to check in with us.
dialogue.accepted: Thank you.
dialogue.rejected: Oh well.  I hope he turns up soon.
dialogue.advice: He might be on the property somewhere, maybe by that old cabin near the entrance, sometimes he camps there.
dialogue.success: Thanks, I was getting ready to go look myself.  Now that I have the anvil, I've been working on new armor for the horses, take this prototype I made.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: I hope he didn't meet Barry's fate…

MISSION_ISHERWOOD_CHRIS_1.name: Free Barry from the mysterious structure
MISSION_ISHERWOOD_CHRIS_1.name_plural: Free Barry from the mysterious structures

dialogue.describe: We need to investigate the alien encampment and try to find out what happened to Barry.
dialogue.offer: I can take you to the structure, I tracked them to it.
dialogue.accepted: Awesome, I want some answers!
dialogue.rejected: Thanks anyway, I'll keep my eye on it, maybe I'll find a way one day.
dialogue.advice: I feel like we are underprepared if they see us, I marked the location for you.
dialogue.success: It's taller then I remember, we should look for prisoners.  I left a note for my family before we left.  If we survive, the cabin should be fixed up and ready for you to move in if you want to stay.
dialogue.success_lie: Well it was here…
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.describe: I could use some help foraging ingredients.
dialogue.offer: I could use some fresh dandelions for the next batch of wine.  Can you bring me 50 dandelions?
dialogue.accepted: Thank you, I'll put these to good use.
dialogue.rejected: Oh well.  Maybe some other time, thanks.
dialogue.advice: You can find them in the fields during the spring and summer months.
dialogue.success: Thanks.  Here's a small reward to show my appreciation for your help.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: I wonder if the wildlife ate all the greens…

dialogue.describe: I could use some seeds from the forest.
dialogue.offer: We could use some seeds for the next planting season.  Can you bring me 20 bee balm seeds?
dialogue.accepted: Thank you.  It's important to have a good stock before the flu season hits.
dialogue.rejected: Oh well.  Maybe some other time, thanks.
dialogue.advice: You should search through the forest, make sure to check in the underbrush for beebalm and then harvest its seeds.
dialogue.success: Wow, perfect.  Here are some of my own remedies and if those don't work try my other gift.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: I'll have to find someone more at home in the forest…

dialogue.describe: I could use a barn cat to keep the mice down.
dialogue.offer: I saw some feral cats out by the old cabin.  Can you capture one for me?
dialogue.accepted: Thank you!  Please hurry back!  Take this cage so you have a chance of capturing one.
dialogue.rejected: I didn't want to use chemicals on these rats.
dialogue.advice: Take this pet carrier; if you can get close to a cat, you can put it inside.  If you're having problems, try befriending it with cat food.
dialogue.success: Thank you so much, I want you to have this copy of my natural remedy journal.  I'll name this handsome fellow Joshua.
dialogue.success_lie: What?!  You're lying, I can tell!  Did you even bring back my cage?
dialogue.failure: Oh no!  I guess they are too nimble for you…

dialogue.describe: We need to build some kilns.
dialogue.offer: I could use 120 rocks to construct some kilns.
dialogue.accepted: You can break up some larger stones, or gather them up from the fields.
dialogue.rejected: Thanks anyway, we'll find the time to get them ourselves.
dialogue.advice: Mining would always be an option if you had the resources.
dialogue.success: I appreciate it, this will make Luke happy.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.describe: I do have some resource gathering I could use help with.
dialogue.offer: Now that the forge is set up, we could use 2000 units of sand to get production going.
dialogue.accepted: Thank you.
dialogue.rejected: Oh well.  I'll try to find time to get it myself, thanks.
dialogue.advice: You can find it along river banks, or maybe landscaping supplies and hardware stores.
dialogue.success: Thanks, now Luke can get started.  Here's a token of my thanks.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: I wonder where all the sand went…

dialogue.describe: I do have some resource gathering I could use help if you have time.
dialogue.offer: Now that the clay kiln is set up, we could use 1000 units of clay to get production going.
dialogue.accepted: Thank you.
dialogue.rejected: Oh well.  I'll try to find time to get it myself, thanks.
dialogue.advice: You can find it along river banks, or maybe look for deposits in the forest.
dialogue.success: Thanks, now Luke can get started making jugs, We'd like to give you a cow, Here's Daisy, take good care of her and she'll provide you with milk.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: I wonder where all the sand went…

dialogue.describe: I could use some help scavenging.
dialogue.offer: We could use some 3 liter jars to preserve our produce.  Can you bring me 20 large three liter jars?  I'll give you some preserves in exchange.
dialogue.accepted: Thank you.  It's important to preserve foods while we can.
dialogue.rejected: Oh well.  I'll see if I can find another way, thanks.
dialogue.advice: Grocery stores, house kitchens, there's plenty of places to look.
dialogue.success: Wow, perfect.  Thanks.  Here's your reward.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: I wonder where all the jars went…

dialogue.describe: I do have some more scavenging for you.
dialogue.offer: We could use some seeds for the next planting season.  Can you bring me 100 wheat seeds?  I'll give you some fresh produce.
dialogue.accepted: Thank you.  It's important to preserve healthy foods while we can.
dialogue.rejected: Oh well.  I'll see if I can find another supplier, thanks.
dialogue.advice: Grocery stores, house kitchens, there's plenty of places to look.
dialogue.success: Wow, perfect.  Thanks.  Here's your reward.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: I wonder where all the seeds went…

dialogue.describe: We could use some help killing some wolves.
dialogue.offer: There's been some wolves that keep scaring our chickens and horses, I'd be grateful if you can kill them.
dialogue.accepted: Wonderful, let me know when it is done.
dialogue.rejected: Thanks anyway, we will try some traps.
dialogue.advice: A gun will probably help.
dialogue.success: I appreciate it, I've got this old saddle I want you to have.  I'll be happy to put a horse under it if you want to do some more heroics.
dialogue.success_lie: Show me the bodies.
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.describe: We could use some help killing some monsters.
dialogue.offer: We could use some help killing a pack of monsters.  I don't know what they are, but they're very fast, I'm willing to outfit you with a horse if you succeed.
dialogue.accepted: Be ready for anything.
dialogue.rejected: I guess we can try some traps, but we could really use the help.
dialogue.advice: Bring something big if you've got the firepower, and keep your distance.
dialogue.success: I appreciate it, this will help keep our animals safe.  This is, Steve, he's a good, steady horse.  You should talk to Carlos about some armor for him.
dialogue.success_lie: Show me the bodies.
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

MISSION_ISHERWOOD_LUKE_1.name: Find The Art of Glassblowing book
MISSION_ISHERWOOD_LUKE_1.name_plural: Find The Art of Glassblowing books

dialogue.describe: I need more knowledge to get the glass blowing started.
dialogue.offer: I could really use a book on glass blowing.  With the internet gone, I don't have any handy references.
dialogue.accepted: Fantastic, I'm not supposed to leave our land.
dialogue.rejected: Oh well, figured I'd have to do a lot of practice anyway.
dialogue.advice: A library, bookstore or a glass blower's studio should have one.
dialogue.success: I appreciate it, this will make my life so much easier.
dialogue.success_lie: I don't see a book…?
dialogue.failure: At least you escaped with your life…

MISSION_ISHERWOOD_LUKE_2.name: Find a copy of DIY Compendium
MISSION_ISHERWOOD_LUKE_2.name_plural: Find a copy of DIY Compendiums

dialogue.describe: I need more knowledge to get better pottery.
dialogue.offer: I could really use the book, DIY Compendium.  With the internet gone, I don't have any handy references.
dialogue.accepted: Fantastic, I'm not supposed to leave our land.
dialogue.rejected: Oh well, figured I'd have to do a lot of practice anyway.
dialogue.advice: A library, bookstore should have one, schools are another good idea.
dialogue.success: I appreciate it, this will make my life so much easier.
dialogue.success_lie: I don't see a book…?
dialogue.failure: At least you escaped with your life…

MISSION_GET_DRIVEBELTS.name: Find Drive Belts
MISSION_GET_DRIVEBELTS.description: Obtain 3 drive belts or makeshift drive belts in exchange for credit with the loggers.

dialogue.offer: Some of our machinery received some damage before <the_cataclysm> and we were waiting on replacement parts.  Now everything's changed and those parts are more important than ever.  Get us three drive belts and I'll give you some credit with us.
dialogue.advice: If you can't find actual drive belts on engines, a good replacement can be made from a belt and some duct tape.  Nothing difficult.
dialogue.accepted: I'll be here when you get back.  Good luck!
dialogue.rejected: Someone's got to do it.
dialogue.success: Wonderful!  Thanks, <name_g>, we'll be fine for a long while from now.
dialogue.success_lie: Where are they?  I don't believe you.
dialogue.failure: That's unfortunate.  I guess we'll have to find someone else to do it.

MISSION_LUMBERMILL_GET_1000_NAILS.name: Get 1,000 Nails
MISSION_LUMBERMILL_GET_1000_NAILS.description: Obtain 1,000 nails in exchange for credit with the loggers.

dialogue.offer: Along with those drive belts, we were waiting for some nails for structural repairs.  Due to <the_cataclysm>, we obviously never received them.  So, I need you to get us 1,000 nails.  We'll pay you fairly.
dialogue.advice: Taking apart some furniture in town should get what you need.
dialogue.accepted: I'll be here when you get back.  Good luck!
dialogue.rejected: Someone's got to do it.
dialogue.success: Our warehouse was about to fall apart.  These will be extremely helpful to us.
dialogue.success_lie: Where are they?  I don't believe you.
dialogue.failure: That's unfortunate.  I guess we'll have to find someone else to do it.

MISSION_LUMBERMILL_GET_6800_NAILS.name: Get 6,800 Nails
MISSION_LUMBERMILL_GET_6800_NAILS.description: Obtain 6,800 nails in exchange for credit with the loggers.

dialogue.offer: While fairly sturdy, the metal fence around this place won't hold out for long.  So, we've decided to replace it with a wall.  However, the nails we had were used to repair our existing structures, and they weren't nearly enough.  After some calculations, we need 6,800 nails to do it.  That may seem like a lot, but we're willing to give you a TON of credit for it.
dialogue.advice: You might have to do more than just scrapping a bunch of furniture.  Dismantling a building somewhere in town could get you what you need.
dialogue.accepted: I'll be here when you get back.  Good luck!
dialogue.rejected: Well, I suppose that's reasonable.
dialogue.success: That's absolutely amazing!  I can't thank you enough for this!
dialogue.success_lie: You're a fucking scammer, <name_b>!
dialogue.failure: That's unfortunate.  I guess we'll have to find someone else to do it.

MISSION_LUMBERMILL_GET_6_BLANKETS.name: Find 6 Blankets
MISSION_LUMBERMILL_GET_6_BLANKETS.description: Obtain 6 blankets, fur blankets, electric blankets etc in exchange for credit with the loggers.

dialogue.offer: Now that we should be safe from harm, I decided to start adding a few things to this place.  Right now, we don't have anywhere to comfortably sleep, so we're building a small sleeping quarter.  We just need 6 big, warm blankets to finish our project.
dialogue.advice: I figure any hotel or motel in town should have lots of blankets, whatever types you can find for us.
dialogue.accepted: I'll be here when you get back.  Good luck!
dialogue.rejected: Well, someone's got to do it.
dialogue.inquire: Did you find us some bedding yet?
dialogue.success: Thanks!  Feel free to sleep here if you want.  It's the least we can do for the help.
dialogue.success_lie: How is this supposed to help us?
dialogue.failure: That's unfortunate.  I guess we'll have to find someone else to do it.

MISSION_LUMBERMILL_SET_TRADE_ROUTE.name: Establish A Trade Route
MISSION_LUMBERMILL_SET_TRADE_ROUTE.description: Establish trade relations between the loggers and a refugee center, and bring back a writ of the agreement.

dialogue.offer: While some of us were out scavenging, we spotted an old evac shelter that looks like it might have some people inside.  I want you to go over there, find whoever runs the joint, and see if we can make a deal with them for some processed lumber.  This will be invaluable to our survival.
dialogue.advice: It should be pretty simple making the deal, but I'd recommend taking a car over there myself.
dialogue.accepted: I'll be here when you get back.  Good luck!
dialogue.rejected: Please give it a try?  This is really important to us.
dialogue.inquire: What did they say about the deal?
dialogue.success: Thank you!  We're set for life on this one!
dialogue.success_lie: How does this help us?
dialogue.failure: That's unfortunate.  I guess we'll have to find someone else to trade with.

MISSION_EXPLORE_SARCOPHAGUS.name: Follow Sarcophagus Team
MISSION_EXPLORE_SARCOPHAGUS.description: Lead this person with you into a <color_pink>Hazardous Waste Sarcophagus</color>, then talk to them once you've <color_light_red>entered the lower level</color>.

dialogue.describe: You wouldn't believe what I found…
dialogue.offer: Holy hell, the crash you recovered the black box from wasn't as old as I thought.  Check this out, it was on its approach to pick up a team sent to secure and destroy something called a 'Hazardous Waste Sarcophagus' in the middle of nowhere.  If the bird never picked up the team then we may still have a chance to meet up with them.  It includes an access code for the elevator and an encoded message for the team leader, I guess.  If we want to join up with what remains of the government then now may be our only chance.
dialogue.accepted: Fuck ya, America!
dialogue.rejected: Are you going to forfeit your duty when the country needs you the most?
dialogue.advice: If there is a military team down there then we better go in prepared if we want to impress them.  Carry as much ammo as you can and prepare to ditch this place if they have a second bird coming to pick them up.
dialogue.inquire: Having any trouble following the map?
dialogue.success: We got this shit!
dialogue.success_lie: What?!  I out'ta whip your ass.
dialogue.failure: Damn, we were so close.

MISSION_GET_INHALER.name: Find Inhaler
MISSION_GET_INHALER.description: If you don't find an <color_light_blue>inhaler</color> for this person within the time limit, they will <color_red>most likely die</color>.

dialogue.offer: I'm asthmatic.  I need you to get an inhaler for me…
dialogue.accepted: Oh, thank god, thank you so much!  I won't last more than a couple of days, so hurry…
dialogue.rejected: What?!  Please, <ill_die> without your help!
dialogue.advice: There's a town nearby.  Check pharmacies; it'll be behind the counter.
dialogue.success: Oh thank god!  I'll be right as rain in no time.
dialogue.success_lie: What?!  You're lying, I can tell!  Ugh, forget it!
dialogue.failure: How am I not dead already?!

MISSION_GET_ANTIBIOTICS.name: Find Antibiotics
MISSION_GET_ANTIBIOTICS.description: If you don't find <color_light_blue>antibiotics</color> for this person within the time limit, they will <color_red>most likely die</color>.

dialogue.offer: I'm infected.  Badly.  I need you to get some antibiotics for me…
dialogue.accepted: Oh, thank god, thank you so much!  I won't last more than a couple of days, so hurry…
dialogue.rejected: What?!  Please, <ill_die> without your help!
dialogue.advice: There's a town nearby.  Check pharmacies; it'll be behind the counter.
dialogue.success: Oh thank god!  I'll be right as rain in no time.
dialogue.success_lie: What?!  You're lying, I can tell!  Ugh, forget it!
dialogue.failure: How am I not dead already?!

MISSION_GET_BLACK_BOX.name: Retrieve Military Black Box
MISSION_GET_BLACK_BOX.description: Obtain a <color_light_blue>black box</color> from a military helicoper, crashed or otherwise, and <color_light_red>extract it from the vehicle</color>.

dialogue.describe: We've got the flag, now we need to locate US forces.
dialogue.offer: We have the flag but now we need to locate US troops to see what we can do to help.  I haven't seen any but I'm figure'n one of those choppers that were fly'n round during th' outbreak would have a good idea.  If you can get me a black box from one of the wrecks I'll look into where we might open'er at.
dialogue.accepted: Fuck ya, America!
dialogue.rejected: Do you have any better ideas?
dialogue.advice: Survivors were talking about them crashing but I don't know where.  If I were a pilot I'd avoid crash landing in a city or forest though.
dialogue.success: America, fuck ya!
dialogue.success_lie: What?!  I out'ta whip you're ass.
dialogue.failure: Damn, I'll have to find'er myself.

MISSION_GET_BLACK_BOX_TRANSCRIPT.name: Retrieve Black Box Transcript
MISSION_GET_BLACK_BOX_TRANSCRIPT.description: Bring the black box with you into a <color_light_blue>science lab</color>, in order to find a working terminal that might allow you to <color_light_red>access the data on the black box</color>.

dialogue.describe: With the black box in hand, we need to find a lab.
dialogue.offer: Thanks to your searching we've got the black box but now we need to have a look'n-side her.  Now, most buildings don't have power anymore but there are a few that might be of use.  Have you ever seen one of those science labs that have popped up in the middle of nowhere?  Them suckers have a glowing terminal out front so I know they have power somewhere inside'em.  If you can get inside and find a computer lab that still works you ought to be able to find out what's in the black box.
dialogue.accepted: Fuck ya, America!
dialogue.rejected: Do you have any better ideas?
dialogue.advice: When I was play'n with the terminal for the one I ran into it kept asking for an ID card.  Finding one would be the first order of business.
dialogue.success: America, fuck ya!  I was in the guard a few years back so I'm confident I can make heads-or-tails of these transmissions.
dialogue.success_lie: What?!  I out'ta whip you're ass.
dialogue.failure: Damn, I maybe we can find an egg-head to crack the terminal.

dialogue.offer: I hope you will find use from what you got out of the deposit box but I also have another job for you that might lead you to an opportunity to deal out justice for those who cannot.  First things first, we can't just look like ruffians.  Find us a deputy badge, easy enough?
dialogue.accepted: I'd check the police station.
dialogue.rejected: We're also official… just hang in there and I'll show you what we can really do.
dialogue.advice: They shouldn't be that hard to find… should they?
dialogue.success: Great work, Deputy.  We're in business.
dialogue.success_lie: Thanks for trying…  I guess.
dialogue.failure: The day of reckoning will come for the criminals if it hasn't already.

dialogue.describe: Does our flag still yet wave?
dialogue.offer: Does our flag still yet wave?  We're battered but not yet out of the fight, we need the old colors!
dialogue.accepted: Hell ya!  Find me one of those big ol' American flags.
dialogue.rejected: Seriously?  God damned commie…
dialogue.advice: Find a large federal building or school, they must have one.
dialogue.success: America, fuck ya!
dialogue.success_lie: What?!  You liar!
dialogue.failure: You give up?  This country fell apart because no one could find a good man to rely on… might as well give up, I guess.

dialogue.offer: Our world fell apart because our leaders were as crooked as the con-men that paid for their elections.  Just find me one of those corporate accounting books and I'll show you and the rest of the world just who is at fault.
dialogue.accepted: You'll see, I know I'm right.
dialogue.rejected: I know it isn't pressing but the big corporations didn't get a chance to destroy the evidence yet.
dialogue.advice: Try a big corporate building of some sort, they're bound to have an accounting department.
dialogue.success: Great, let's see… uh… hmmm…  Fine, I didn't even do my own taxes but I'm sure this will prove their guilt if we get an expert to examine it.
dialogue.success_lie: Thanks for trying…  I guess.
dialogue.failure: The day of reckoning will come for the corporations if it hasn't already.

dialogue.describe: I hope I don't see many names I know…
dialogue.offer: I've lost so many friends… please find me a patient list from the regional hospital or doctor's office.  I just want to know who might still be out there.
dialogue.accepted: Thank you, I suppose it won't change what has already happened but it will bring me closure.
dialogue.rejected: Please, I just want to know what happened to everyone.
dialogue.advice: I bet you'll run into a lot of those things in the hospital, please be careful.
dialogue.success: Oh dear, I thought Timmy would have made it…
dialogue.success_lie: Thanks for trying…  I guess.
dialogue.failure: I bet some of them are still out there…

dialogue.describe: I wonder if a retreat might exist…
dialogue.offer: Everyone who dies gets back up, right?  Which means that whatever is causing this it must be airborne to have infected everyone.  I believe that if that is the case then there should be regions that were not downwind from where-ever the disease was released.  We need to find a record of all the weather patterns leading up to the outbreak.
dialogue.accepted: Thanks so much, you may save both of us yet.
dialogue.rejected: Ya, it was a long shot I admit.
dialogue.advice: I'm not sure, maybe a news station would have what we are looking for?
dialogue.success: These look more complicated than I thought, just give me some time.
dialogue.success_lie: This isn't what we need.
dialogue.failure: If only we could find a great valley or something.

dialogue.describe: St. Michael the archangel defend me in battle…
dialogue.offer: As the world seems to abandon the reality that we once knew, it becomes plausible that the old superstitions that were cast aside may have had some truth to them.  Please go and find me a religious relic…  I doubt it will be of much use but I've got to hope in something.
dialogue.accepted: I wish you the best of luck, may whatever god you please guide your path.
dialogue.rejected: Ya, I guess the stress may just be getting to me…
dialogue.advice: I suppose a large church or cathedral may have something.
dialogue.inquire: Any luck?  Please find me a small relic.  Any relic will do.
dialogue.success: Thank you, I need some time alone now…
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.offer: Now I don't mean to upset you but I'm not sure what I can do with the accounting ledger at the moment.  We do have a new lead though, the ledger has a safe deposit box under the regional manager's name.  Guess what, dumb sucker wrote down his combination.  Come with me to retrieve the box and you can keep any of the goodies in it that I can't use to press charges against these bastards.
dialogue.accepted: You may make a tidy profit from this.
dialogue.rejected: I know it isn't pressing but the world is going to be just as corrupt when we start rebuilding unless we take measure to stop those who seek to rule over us.
dialogue.advice: This shouldn't be hard unless we run into a horde.
dialogue.success: Great, anything I can't use to prosecute the bastards is yours, as promised.
dialogue.success_lie: Thanks for trying…  I guess.
dialogue.failure: The day of reckoning will come for the corporations if it hasn't already.

MISSION_GET_SOFTWARE.name: Retrieve Software
MISSION_GET_SOFTWARE.description: Visit the location this person requested you to visit and <color_light_red>access the terminal their software is stored on</color>.  You'll need to bring an <color_light_blue>empty USB drive</color> with you.

dialogue.describe: Oh man, I can't believe I forgot to download it…
dialogue.offer: There's some important software on my computer that I need on USB.
dialogue.accepted: Thanks!  Just pull the data onto this USB drive and bring it to me.
dialogue.rejected: Seriously?  It's an easy job…
dialogue.advice: Take this USB drive.  Use the console, and download the software.
dialogue.inquire: So, do you have my software yet?
dialogue.success: Excellent, thank you!
dialogue.success_lie: What?!  You liar!
dialogue.failure: Wow, you failed?  All that work, down the drain…

MISSION_GET_ZOMBIE_BLOOD_ANAL.name: Analyze Zombie Blood
MISSION_GET_ZOMBIE_BLOOD_ANAL.description: Use a <color_light_blue>blood draw kit</color> to extract <color_red>tainted blood</color> from a zombie, then bring the blood sample to a <color_red>hospital</color> and locate a centrifuge to analyze the blood with.

dialogue.describe: It could be very informative to perform an analysis of zombie blood…
dialogue.offer: I need someone to get a sample of zombie blood, take it to a hospital, and perform a centrifuge analysis of it.
dialogue.accepted: Excellent.  Take this blood draw kit; once you've produced a zombie corpse, use it to extract blood from the body, then take it to a hospital for analysis.
dialogue.rejected: Are you sure?  The scientific value of that blood data could be priceless…
dialogue.advice: The centrifuge is a bit technical; you might want to study up on the usage of computers before completing that part.
dialogue.inquire: Well, do you have the data yet?
dialogue.success: Excellent!  This may be the key to removing the infection.
dialogue.success_lie: Wait, you couldn't possibly have the data!  Liar!
dialogue.failure: What a shame, that data could have proved invaluable…

dialogue.describe: St. Michael the archangel defend me in battle…
dialogue.offer: You have no idea how interesting this diary is.  I have two very promising leads…  First things first, the Catholic Church has been performing its own investigations into global cult phenomenon and it appears to have become very interested in a local cult as of recently.  Could you investigate a location for me?  I'm not sure what was going on here but the priest seemed fairly worried about it.
dialogue.accepted: I wish you the best of luck, may whatever god you please guide your path…  You may need it this time more than the past excursions you have gone on.  There is a note about potential human sacrifice in the days immediately before and after the outbreak.  The name of the cult is believed to be the Church of Starry Wisdom but it is noted that accounts differ.
dialogue.rejected: Ya, I guess the stress may just be getting to me…
dialogue.advice: I doubt the site is still occupied but I'd carry a firearm at least…  I'm not sure what you might be looking for but I'm positive you'll find something out of the ordinary if you look long enough.
dialogue.inquire: I'm positive there is something there… there has to be, any luck?
dialogue.success: Thank you, your account of these… demonic creations proves the fears the churches had were well founded.  Our priority should be routing out any survivors of this cult…  I don't known if they are responsible for the outbreak but they certainly know more about it than I do.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.describe: St. Michael the archangel defend me in battle…
dialogue.offer: I have another task if you are feeling up to it.  There is a prisoner that the priest made special mention of.  I was wondering if you could see what may have happened to him or if he left anything in his cell.  The priest admits the individual is rather unstable, to put it lightly, but the priest personally believed the man was some kind of repentant visionary.  I'm not in a position to cast out the account just yet… it seems the man has prophesied events accurately before concerning the Church of Starry Wisdom.
dialogue.accepted: I wish you the best of luck, may whatever god you please guide your path…  I can only imagine that the prison will be a little slice of hell.  I'm not sure what they would have decided to do with the inmates when they knew death was almost certain.
dialogue.rejected: Ya, I guess the stress may just be getting to me…
dialogue.advice: The worst case scenario will probably be that the prisoners have escaped their cells and turned the building into their own little fortress.  Best case, the building went into lock-down and secured the prisoners in their cells.  Either way, navigating the building will pose its own difficulties.
dialogue.success: Things were even worse than I feared, weren't they?  Thank you, I'm not sure what to make of this but I'll ponder your account.  It may have been too late to save him, but his writings may still prove useful in time.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.describe: Well damn, you must be the guys here to pick me up…
dialogue.offer: I got the brief so I know what I'm getting into.  Let me be upfront, treat me like shit and I'm going to cover my own hide.  However, you treat me well and give me something to believe in, even if it's just a shiny bit of metal, and I'll do you right.  Without a strong band a man doesn't stand a chance in this world.  You ready to take charge boss?  This world could use a Sheriff just about now.
dialogue.accepted: Before we get into a major fight just make sure we have the gear we need, boss.
dialogue.rejected: I don't think you're going to find many other survivors who haven't taken up a faction yet.
dialogue.advice: I'm a pretty good shot with a rifle or pistol.
dialogue.success: Wait… are you really making me a deputy?
dialogue.success_lie: I don't think so…
dialogue.failure: Quitting already?

dialogue.describe: You seem to know this new world better than most…
dialogue.offer: You're kitted out better than most… would you be interested in making this world a little better for the rest of us?  The towns have enough supplies for us survivors to start securing a foothold but we don't have anyone with the skills and equipment to thin the masses of undead.  I'll lend you a hand to the best of my ability but you really showed promise taking out that other beast.  You, I, and a 100 zombies laid to rest, what do you say?
dialogue.accepted: Hell ya, we may get ourselves killed but we'll be among the first legends of the apocalypse.
dialogue.rejected: Hey, I know I wouldn't volunteer for it either… but then I remember that most of us survivors won't make it unless someone decides to take the initiative.
dialogue.advice: I'd secure an ammo cache and try to sweep a town in multiple passes.
dialogue.success: Man… you're a goddamn machine.  It was a pleasure working with you.  You know, you may just change our little neck of the world if you keep this up.
dialogue.success_lie: I don't think that was quite a hundred dead zeds.
dialogue.failure: Quitting already?

dialogue.describe: You seem to know this new world better than most…
dialogue.offer: We've got another problem to deal with but I don't think we can handle it on our own.  So, I sent word out and found us a volunteer… of sorts.  He's vain as hell but has a little skill with firearms.  He was supposed to collect whatever he had of value and is going to meet us at a cabin in the woods.  Wasn't sure how long we were going to be so I told him to just camp there until we picked him up.
dialogue.accepted: Rodger, if he's a no-show then any other gunslinger will do… but I doubt he'll quit before we even begin.
dialogue.rejected: Hey, I know I wouldn't volunteer for it either… but then I remember that most of us survivors won't make it unless someone decides to take the initiative.
dialogue.advice: I hope the bastard is packing heat… else we'll need to grab him a gun before we hit our next target.
dialogue.success: Great, just let me know when you are ready to wade knee-deep in an ocean of blood.
dialogue.success_lie: I don't think so…
dialogue.failure: Quitting already?

dialogue.describe: I've heard some bad rumors so I hope you are up for another challenge…
dialogue.offer: From what I overheard from your new deputy, an unusually dense horde of undead recently moving into the area.  At the center of this throng there was a 'leader' of some sort.  The short of it is, kill the son of a bitch.  We don't know what it is capable of or why it is surrounded by other zombies but this thing reeks of trouble.  Do whatever it takes but we can't risk it getting away.
dialogue.accepted: I'll lend you a hand but I'd try and recruit another gunslinger if you can.
dialogue.rejected: What's the use of walking away, they'll track you down eventually.
dialogue.advice: Don't risk torching the area it may be hiding in.  The sucker may still be alive under the rubble and ash.
dialogue.success: May that bastard never get up again.
dialogue.success_lie: I don't think we got it yet.
dialogue.failure: Quitting already?

MISSION_KILL_NEMESIS.name: Kill Your Pursuer
MISSION_KILL_NEMESIS.description: Since the start of the Cataclysm, something has been hunting you relentlessly.  You can outrun it but never truly escape it.  It won't end until one of you dies.

dialogue.describe: The eater of the dead… something was ripping zombies to shreds and only leaving a few scattered limbs…
dialogue.offer: A few days ago another survivor and I were trying to avoid the cities by staying in the woods during the day and foraging for gear at night.  It worked well against the normal zed's but one night something caught onto our trail and chased us for ten minutes or so until we decided to split up and meet-up back here.  My buddy never showed up and I don't have the means to kill whatever it was.  Can you lend a hand?
dialogue.accepted: Thanks, make sure you're ready for whatever the beast is.
dialogue.rejected: Hey, I know I wouldn't volunteer for it either.
dialogue.advice: I'd carry a shotgun at least, it sounded pretty big.
dialogue.success: You look a little shaken up, I can't tell you how glad I am that you killed it though.
dialogue.success_lie: Something in the shadows still seems to stare at me when I look at the woods.
dialogue.failure: I'm glad you came back alive…  I wasn't sure if I had sent you to your death.

dialogue.describe: Oh god, I can't believe it happened…
dialogue.offer: My mom… she's… she was killed, but then she just got back up… she's one of those things now.  Can you put her out of her misery for me?
dialogue.accepted: Thank you… she would've wanted it this way.
dialogue.rejected: Please reconsider, I know she's suffering…
dialogue.advice: Find a gun if you can, make it quick…
dialogue.inquire: Well…?  Did you… finish things for my mom?
dialogue.success: Thank you.  I couldn't rest until I knew that was finished.
dialogue.success_lie: What?!  You're lying, I can tell!  Ugh, forget it!
dialogue.failure: Really… that's too bad.

MISSION_REACH_FARM_HOUSE.name: Reach Farm House
MISSION_REACH_FARM_HOUSE.description: Lead this person with you into a <color_brown>Farm</color>, then talk to them once you've <color_light_red>reached the farm house</color>.

dialogue.describe: I just need a place to start over…
dialogue.offer: I've accepted that everyone I used to know is dead… one way or another.  I really wish I could have done something to save my brother but he was one of the first to go.  I'd like to start over, just rebuild at one of the farms in the countryside.  Can you help me secure one?
dialogue.accepted: Thank you, let's find a remote one so we don't have to worry about many zombies.
dialogue.rejected: Please, I just don't know what to do otherwise.
dialogue.advice: Traveling the backroads would be a good way to search for one.
dialogue.inquire: Shall we keep looking for a farm house?
dialogue.success: Well, my adventuring days are over.  I can't thank you enough.  Trying to make this place self sustaining will take some work but the future is looking brighter.  At least it ought to be safe for now.  You'll always be welcome here.
dialogue.success_lie: Thanks for trying…  I guess.
dialogue.failure: I guess it was just a pipe dream.

MISSION_REACH_FEMA_CAMP.name: Reach FEMA Camp
MISSION_REACH_FEMA_CAMP.description: Lead this person with you into a <color_blue>FEMA Camp</color>, then talk to them once you've <color_light_red>reached the main entrance</color>.

dialogue.describe: Maybe they escaped to one of the camps…
dialogue.offer: I can't thank you enough for bringing me the patient records but I do have another request.  You seem to know your way around… could you take me to one of the FEMA camps?  I know some were overrun but I don't want to believe all of them could have fallen.
dialogue.accepted: Thank you, just bring me to the camp…  I just want to see.
dialogue.rejected: Please, I don't know what else to do.
dialogue.advice: We should go at night, if it is overrun then we can quickly make our escape.
dialogue.inquire: Any leads on where a camp might be?
dialogue.success: I guess this wasn't as bright an idea as I thought.
dialogue.success_lie: Thanks for trying…  I guess.
dialogue.failure: I bet some of them are still out there…

MISSION_HELICOPTER_REFUEL.name: Refuel your aircraft.
MISSION_HELICOPTER_REFUEL.description: You were flying towards a nearby private airport before your forced landing.  You could still reach it by ground, and scavenge it for fuel.

MISSION_LAST_DELIVERY.name: Finish The Delivery
MISSION_LAST_DELIVERY.description: Reach the mansion and finish this delivery.

dialogue.describe: St. Michael the archangel defend me in battle…
dialogue.offer: From what I understand, the creatures you encountered surrounding this relic were unlike anything I've heard of.  It is laughable that I now consider the living dead to be part of our ordinary reality.  Never-the-less, the church must have some explanation for these events.  I have located the residence of a local clergy man, could you go to this address and recover any items that may reveal what the church's stance is on these events?
dialogue.accepted: I wish you the best of luck, may whatever god you please guide your path.
dialogue.rejected: Ya, I guess the stress may just be getting to me…
dialogue.advice: If the information is confidential the priest must have it hidden within his own home.
dialogue.success: Thank you, a diary is exactly what I was looking for.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.offer: I left my poor dog in a house, not far from here.  Can you retrieve it?
dialogue.accepted: Thank you!  Please hurry back!
dialogue.rejected: Please, think of my poor little puppy!
dialogue.advice: Take my dog whistle; if the dog starts running off, blow it and he'll return to your side.
dialogue.inquire: Have you found my dog yet?
dialogue.success: Thank you so much for finding him!
dialogue.success_lie: What?!  You're lying, I can tell!  Ugh, forget it!
dialogue.failure: Oh no!  My poor puppy…

MISSION_GET_CITY_COP_MOMENTO.name: Retrieve Family Photo
MISSION_GET_CITY_COP_MOMENTO.description: Break into armory to retrieve family photo.

dialogue.describe: I need you to get my family photo from the armory safe.
dialogue.offer: I left the only photo I have from my family in the armory.  I don't have the code, can you get in?
dialogue.accepted: Thanks, it's great to see someone willing to help a out.
dialogue.rejected: Well, I'll find someone else to do it for me, real shame with all those guns locked up too…
dialogue.advice: You look like a resourceful sort, maybe you can hack it or something.
dialogue.inquire: Got the photo?  Should've been in my gun safe.
dialogue.success: Thanks!  I'll be sure to put in a good word for you around town.
dialogue.success_lie: OK, then hand it over.
dialogue.failure: Shit happens.

dialogue.offer: Show me the proof of your loyalty to the great Foodplace, and I'll consider you worthy of my friendship.  Ten loyalty cards should be enough, I'm sure you already have much more than that waiting for you at home, right?
dialogue.accepted: That's the spirit!  Good luck kid.
dialogue.rejected: That's alright not everyone is cutout for this.
dialogue.advice: Those are very precious, people would probably keep them on their person or in bank vaults.  And definitely not throw them in the trash!
dialogue.inquire: How is it going?  Do you have them?
dialogue.success: YES!  I knew you could do it!  You proved your worth and I'm proud to call you a friend.
dialogue.success_lie: Well…  where are they?
dialogue.failure: I'm so disappointed in you kid…

MISSION_PROVE_YOU_ARE_A_SURVIVOR.name: Prove You're A Survivor
MISSION_PROVE_YOU_ARE_A_SURVIVOR.description: Prove you're a survivor by surviving for 7 days after the Cataclysm, and then returning to the person who gave you this mission.

dialogue.describe: It's hard to tell who actually has the skills to survive these days…
dialogue.offer: It's hard surviving out here on our own, and we'd probably have a better chance working together.  Problem is, I don't really know you and what you're capable of.  You might have what it takes, or you might not.  Either way, I'm going to need some proof.  Come back in a week and I'll gladly follow you.  It's basically a win-win for me: either you come back and I'll know you've got what it takes, or you don't and I'll know that I was right not to follow you.
dialogue.accepted: I'll see you then…or I won't, and then I'll know I made the right decision.
dialogue.rejected: Ya, it was a long shot I admit.
dialogue.advice: Don't die.  If you're asking me for advice, that doesn't bode well for you.
dialogue.inquire: Don't think it's been a week, but at least you're not dead…yet.
dialogue.success: I'll be honest, I wasn't really expecting to see you again.  A promise is a promise, I'll follow you now!
dialogue.success_lie: I know time is relative and all that.
dialogue.failure: I'm not quite sure how you failed to survive AND are talking to me.

MISSION_LEARN_ABOUT_CATTAIL_JELLY.name: Gather Cattail Stalks
MISSION_LEARN_ABOUT_CATTAIL_JELLY.description: Gather <color_light_blue>20 cattail stalks</color> from the swamp and bring them back to <color_light_red>learn how to craft cattail jelly</color>.  Raise your <color_light_blue>survival skill to at least 1</color> by harvesting cattail stalks or other plants.  <color_light_blue>Bring back the provided bag</color> as well.

dialogue.describe: Medical services are a little sparse following <the_cataclysm>, but people have been surviving using their wits and the bounty of Mother Nature for a long time.  Care to learn a little?
dialogue.offer: Did you know that cattails are a source of a jelly that works as an antiseptic and analgesic?  Something like that is likely to be mighty helpful out here.  I want you to take this bag, head to the nearest swamp, collect 20 cattail stalks, and bring them back here.  In exchange, I'll show you how to harvest the jelly.
