dialogue.accepted: Great!  This bag should be big enough to hold all of the stalks we'll need.  Don't forget to bring it back.
dialogue.rejected: Your loss.
dialogue.advice: The cattails grow in the fresh water in swamps.  You can't miss them.
dialogue.inquire: Got those cattail stalks yet?  Don't forget to bring back my bag and improve your survival skill to at least 1 as well.
dialogue.success: Great!  Hand them over and I'll show you how this works.
dialogue.success_lie: OK, then hand them over.
dialogue.failure: Well, that's a shame.

MISSION_ASSASSINATION.name: One Last Assassination
MISSION_ASSASSINATION.description: Your mission required you to eliminate a certain high-ranking individual in hiding.  Your mark seems to have turned feral while escaping and the world appears to be ending, but not even that can stop you from finishing your mission.

MISSION_DOG_LOVER.name: Protect Your Canine Friends!
MISSION_DOG_LOVER.description: Search any nearby pet stores for armor for your pups. You think you remember the location of one...

MISSION_HEIST_DRIVER.name: The Final Heist
MISSION_HEIST_DRIVER.description: You and your crew swore the last job was the last job - until the dead started getting involved. Now, with old friends, loaded guns, and one impossible score, you’ve got one shot to pull this off before the grave claims you too.

MISSION_HEIST_NEIGHBORHOOD_WATCH.name: Rebuild the Neighborhood
MISSION_HEIST_NEIGHBORHOOD_WATCH.description: The old neighborhood may never be the same - but we can rebuild a new one from the ground up, starting at the hardware store.

MISSION_ONE_BIG_NEST.name: One Big Nest
MISSION_ONE_BIG_NEST.description: This isn’t just another infestation - it’s something new, something bigger than anything you ever had to deal with before the Cataclysm. The nest is massive, the pests inside meaner and tougher than the ones you used to spray and squash. This is the ultimate extermination job: locate the nest, gear up, and clear it out. If you survive, there won’t be anything left inside to crawl back out.

MISSION_TANK_SUPPLY_RUN.name: Supply Run
MISSION_TANK_SUPPLY_RUN.description: The last of your tank's crew was heading to a helipad in the area in search of supplies, and never returned.  They clearly didn't make it, and by now it's probably overrun, but some fuel and ammo would be better than nothing.

MISSION_ONE_LAST_AUDIT.name: One Last Audit
MISSION_ONE_LAST_AUDIT.description: It's said there are only two guarantees in life - death and taxes. You were about to finally take down one of the biggest corporate executives for tax fraud... and then the cataclysm happened. But not even a city full of the dead will stop you from recovering the rightful dues of the United States Federal Government.

dialogue.offer: My communications team went to secure the radio control room after we breached the facility.  I haven't heard from them since, I need you to locate them.  Their first objective was to record all active channels that were transmitting information on other survivors or facilities.  Find them and return the frequency list to me.  I'm sure they could probably use your help also.
dialogue.accepted: Good luck, the communications room shouldn't be far from here.
dialogue.rejected: I don't know why you would bother wasting your time down here if you can't handle a few small tasks…
dialogue.advice: We were briefed that the communications array was on this level.
dialogue.success: Thanks, let me know when you need another tasking.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.offer: Your assistance is greatly appreciated, we need to clear out the more ruthless monsters that are wandering up from the lower levels.  If you could cull twenty or so of what we refer to as 'nightmares' my men would be much safer.  If you've cleared out most of this floor then the lower levels should be your next target.
dialogue.accepted: Good luck, finding a clear passage to the second level may be tricky.
dialogue.rejected: I don't know why you would bother wasting your time down here if you can't handle a few small tasks…
dialogue.advice: These creatures can swing their appendages surprisingly far.
dialogue.success: Thanks, let me know when you need another tasking.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.offer: My chief responsibility is to monitor radio traffic and locate potential targets to secure or rescue.  The majority of radio repeaters are down and those that are working have only emergency power.  If you have a basic understanding of electronics you should be able to fabricate the 'radio repeater mod' found in these plans.  When this mod is attached to a radio station's main terminal, all short range radio traffic on emergency channels is boosted so we can pick it up at much longer ranges.  I really need you make me one.
dialogue.accepted: Thanks, I know the labs on the other side of the complex have electronic parts sitting around.
dialogue.rejected: I don't know why you would bother wasting your time down here if you can't handle a few small tasks…
dialogue.advice: I'm sure the motorpool has a truck battery you could salvage.
dialogue.inquire: Have you had any luck fabricating it?
dialogue.success: Thanks, I'll see to installing this one.  It will be some time but I could use someone to position these around the region.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.offer: I guess I could use your skills once again.  There are small transmitters located in the nearby evacuation shelters; if we don't separate them from the power grid their power systems will rapidly deteriorate over the next few weeks.  The task is rather simple but the shelters offer us a place to redirect refugees until this vault can be secured.
dialogue.accepted: Thanks, I should be ready for you to install the radio repeater mods by the time you get back.
dialogue.rejected: I don't know why you would bother wasting your time down here if you can't handle a few small tasks…
dialogue.advice: Try searching on the outskirts of towns.
dialogue.inquire: Have you had any luck severing the connection?
dialogue.success: We are good to go!  The last of the gear is powering up now.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.offer: Most of my essential gear has been brought back online so it is time for you to install your first radio repeater mod.  Head topside and locate the nearest radio station.  Install the mod on the backup terminal and return to me so that I can verify that everything was successful.  Radio towers must unfortunately be ignored for now, without a dedicated emergency power system they won't be useful for some time.
dialogue.accepted: I'll be standing by down here once you are done.
dialogue.rejected: I don't know why you would bother wasting your time down here if you can't handle a few small tasks…
dialogue.advice: If you could make some sort of directional antenna, it might help locating the radio stations.
dialogue.inquire: Have you had any luck finding a radio station?
dialogue.success: That's one down.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.offer: I could always use you to put another repeater mod up.  I don't have to remind you but every one that goes up extends our response area just a little bit more.  With enough of them we'll be able to maintain communication with anyone in the region.
dialogue.accepted: I'll be standing by.
dialogue.rejected: I don't know why you would bother wasting your time down here if you can't handle a few small tasks…
dialogue.advice: Getting a working vehicle is going to become important as the distance you have to travel increases.
dialogue.inquire: Have you had any luck finding a radio station?
dialogue.success: I'll try and update the captain with any signals that I need investigated.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

MISSION_SEER_GATHER_BONE.name: Gather Bones
MISSION_SEER_GATHER_BONE.description: Gather bones for Brigitte LaCroix.  About 8 should do it.

dialogue.describe: There is always work to be done, song to be woven.
dialogue.offer: If you wish to be set on the path to enlightenment, first you must learn to listen and hear the song.  Go out, butcher a creature and feel the power between your fingertips.  Then bring me the bones and I shall carve them for you.
dialogue.accepted: Excellent.  Now be on your way.
dialogue.rejected: I understand your reluctancy.  Feel free to return when you see the way.
dialogue.advice: The shambling corpses we see all around move in discord.  Their song can be used, but for an Acolyte, this would be needlessly hard.  Be sure to carve an unspoiled living creature.
dialogue.inquire: Have you felt the song in your hands yet?
dialogue.success: And so, another cycle ends.  You have done well.  I will now bestow my mark upon you, so that others may know the path you walk and aid you.
dialogue.success_lie: So you say, but the song sings otherwise.
dialogue.failure: Then you shall try again, until you hear.

dialogue.describe: Gotta start small right?  Little ones for keeping little things safe.  I could use 'em.
dialogue.offer: Gotta start small right?  Little ones for keeping little things safe.  I could use 'em.  I need a bunch of 'em.  Little ones, you know?  Can you bring me like… like… forty?
dialogue.accepted: Oh man, thanks so much my friend.  You won't regret it.
dialogue.rejected: I didn't think so.
dialogue.advice: Watch out, he's looking for it too.
dialogue.success: Oh this is so great, so great!
dialogue.success_lie: Oh this is so great, so great!
dialogue.failure: Oh, that's too bad.  Guess they're eating it all.

MISSION_BEGGAR_2_DUCT_TAPE.name: Bring a roll of duct tape (200 charges)
MISSION_BEGGAR_2_DUCT_TAPE.name_plural: Bring a roll of duct tape (200 charges)s

dialogue.describe: These ones are good, good ones.  They need something to, you know, bind them together.  Surround them, light side, dark side.
dialogue.offer: These ones are good, good ones.  They need something to, you know, bind them together.  Surround them, light side, dark side.  Bring me the Force!
dialogue.accepted: Oh man, thanks so much my friend.  You won't regret it.
dialogue.rejected: I didn't think so.
dialogue.advice: Watch out, he's looking for it too.
dialogue.inquire: It's all around us… but did you get it in a crude matter form?
dialogue.success: Oh this is so great, so great!
dialogue.success_lie: Oh this is so great, so great!
dialogue.failure: Oh, that's too bad.  Guess they're eating it all.

dialogue.describe: Ten bigger ones now please.  The list doesn't lie.  You've done so well.
dialogue.offer: Ten bigger ones now please.  The list doesn't lie.  You've done so well.  I got a little more on the list, but we're more than half there.
dialogue.accepted: Oh man, thanks so much my friend.  You won't regret it.
dialogue.rejected: I didn't think so.
dialogue.advice: Watch out, he's looking for it too.
dialogue.success: I'm so happy now!
dialogue.success_lie: I'm so happy now!
dialogue.failure: Oh, that's too bad.  Guess they're eating it all.

dialogue.describe: If I can set it up in here I won't need it, but they might drive me out, so I guess I need some plastic just in case.  I don't like it, the sandman can smell through plastic, but I think the cardboard is stronger.
dialogue.offer: If I can set it up in here I won't need it, but they might drive me out, so I guess I need some plastic just in case.  I don't like it, the sandman can smell through plastic, but I think the cardboard is stronger.  Please bring me some plastic sheets.
dialogue.accepted: We're almost there, now.
dialogue.rejected: I didn't think so.
dialogue.advice: They keep a lot of this stuff in hardware stores and lumber yards.
dialogue.inquire: I really feel bad sending you on this one, it's dangerous.  Have you found anything?
dialogue.success: Nice, this will do perfectly!
dialogue.success_lie: Nice, this will do perfectly!
dialogue.failure: Oh, that's too bad.

dialogue.describe: This is the last thing I need from you.  I've been collecting the other parts myself, it's been easier with more cardboard around.  Can you bring me five more really big cardboard boxes?
dialogue.offer: This is the last thing I need from you.  I've been collecting the other parts myself, it's been easier with more cardboard around.  Can you bring me five more really big cardboard boxes?  Five more cardboard boxes, as big as it gets.  I have a few already stored up, that should be all I need.
dialogue.accepted: Yes!  The home stretch!
dialogue.rejected: Oh man, but we're so close!
dialogue.advice: Try looking in cargo storage areas.
dialogue.inquire: Did you bring me those last few boxes?
dialogue.success: Brilliant!  You're a true hero.  I'll see if I can find a place to set these up now.
dialogue.success_lie: Brilliant!  You're a true hero.  I'll see if I can find a place to set these up now.
dialogue.failure: No!  Oh god, no, this can't be happening…

dialogue.describe: I have it, I have it all, but I can't find a place to put it.  Will you ask the masters?  Maybe?  I've tried but they ignore me.
dialogue.offer: I have it, I have it all, but I can't find a place to put it.  Will you ask the masters?  Maybe?  I've tried but they ignore me.  I just need a place to put it all, a place I can be safe, and not make anyone upset.
dialogue.accepted: Thank you!  I'm sorry, I thought we were done, but we can do this!
dialogue.rejected: Oh man, but we're so close!
dialogue.advice: Maybe somewhere they can't see me?  Where I can just be me?
dialogue.success: The roof!  So high!  So lofty!  Come see me there, my friend.  I will not disappoint you.
dialogue.success_lie: I don't understand.
dialogue.failure: No!  Oh god, no, this can't be happening…

MISSION_REFUGEE_Boris_CLEANUP.name: Find someone to clean up the back bay.
MISSION_REFUGEE_Boris_CLEANUP.name_plural: Find someone to clean up the back bay.s
MISSION_REFUGEE_Boris_CLEANUP.description: Boris in the refugee center is looking for at least five people to help clean up the back bay

dialogue.describe: Find a few people able to help clean the back, people without too much trauma there.
dialogue.offer: Yes, please.  If you can ask around for someone who can help, I can gather the tools they will need and some payment for them.
dialogue.accepted: You are a kind soul.
dialogue.rejected: Ah well.  I can ask around myself, perhaps.
dialogue.advice: Those of us here in the back have too many bad memories, but perhaps someone who didn't come with the original refugee groups would be less burdened.
dialogue.inquire: Greetings, my friend.  Have you found anyone?
dialogue.success: This has great promise.  Perhaps something to keep me busy will help.  Here, I found some small money to thank you.
dialogue.success_lie: I see…  Well I shall get things in order!
dialogue.failure: No worries.  Let me know if you want to try again.

dialogue.describe: Find a circular saw for Boris.
dialogue.offer: We now have a space to work in, and I have wood and nails to spare.  All I need is a saw.  I would love tablesaw and mitre saw, but I can work with a hand held circular saw for now.  I have looked, and what we have is garbage.  Can you bring me a good one?
dialogue.accepted: You are a kind soul.
dialogue.rejected: Ah well.  I can ask around myself, perhaps.
dialogue.advice: It is not hard to find.  I have even seen them for sale at the merchants, but they save them as trade goods and will not give me as a gift.
dialogue.inquire: Greetings, my friend.  Have you found a saw I can use?
dialogue.success: Ah, good.  VonWalt is good brand, I had a saw like this at home.  Now I shall set to work, and make myself a shop back there.  Oh yes, here is a little payment I saved.
dialogue.success_lie: I see…
dialogue.failure: No worries.  Let me know if you want to try again.

MISSION_REFUGEE_Boris_LAPTOP.name: Bring Boris his son's lost writing.
MISSION_REFUGEE_Boris_LAPTOP.name_plural: Bring Boris his son's lost writing.s

dialogue.offer: If you can find it, it would mean so much to me.  I will give you directions to the shelter where he left it.  It was barely a shelter, broken and torn apart.  It should just be on the floor where it was dropped.
dialogue.accepted: You are a kind soul.
dialogue.rejected: Ah well.  I can ask around myself, perhaps.
dialogue.advice: You can tell it is his because he covered it in stickers.
dialogue.inquire: I know it is a hard thing to hope, but were you able to find Ash's laptop?
dialogue.success: It is so strange to see this again, like a little piece of my old life.  I don't know if I can bring myself to read what's on it yet, but having this piece of him is a great comfort.
dialogue.success_lie: I see…
dialogue.failure: Even that you tried means a lot to me.

dialogue.describe: I could get my real sourdough starter…
dialogue.offer: If you really like this second-rate bread, you could risk your life for something actually worth it.  I left my actual sourdough starter back in the bakery where I worked.  That baby is a hundred years old, and has been in my family for generations… if you can bring him to me, I'll bake you the finest bread you've ever had.
dialogue.accepted: Take care of yourself out there.  And listen, when you bring my sourdough back, I don't want to see a scratch on him, you understand?
dialogue.rejected: I can understand why you think you wouldn't want to risk your life for a bread starter.  You haven't tried that bread.
dialogue.advice: He'll be in the right-hand fridge, in a jar with a picture of the Millennium Falcon on it.
dialogue.inquire: So, you seen my sourdough starter?
dialogue.success: Oh, you will not regret this.  He may not look like much, but he's got it where it counts, kid.  It's gonna take me a few days to revive him after being abandoned so long, but he'll be operational soon and then you can come back for some real bread.
dialogue.success_lie: This ain't it.
dialogue.failure: I am not sure if I'm gonna make it through the Cataclysm without my special jar of goop.

dialogue.describe: Yeah, sure, imagine how things would be if we had some live music around here?  I don't know how much I could thank you, though, if you're looking for payment.  You'd sure be improving the mood, though.
dialogue.offer: I just want a functional acoustic guitar.  Preferably one that hasn't been used to cave in any zombie skulls.
dialogue.accepted: Great!  We'll be makin' music in no time!
dialogue.rejected: Oh well.  I understand your reluctancy… I guess.
dialogue.advice: Well, I'll let you in on a little secret.  Guitars COULD be found at a music store.  Let that one sink in a bit.
dialogue.success: Hell yeah, bud!  You just made a lot of people really happy!  In thanks, I'll have enough cash to offer you more recompense for our little dealings.
dialogue.success_lie: Huh.  This… is something, isn't it.
dialogue.failure: No worries.  They don't grow from trees, but we have time.

MISSION_REFUGEE_Fatima_1.name: Find a copy of the Quran
MISSION_REFUGEE_Fatima_1.name_plural: Find a copy of the Qurans

dialogue.describe: I could use a bit of help to find a copy of the Quran.
dialogue.offer: I feel silly asking this, but here goes.  I've never been really into reading holy books and stuff like that.  I usually went to the mosque on Friday, and I try to pray five times a day but I hardly ever manage it.  I guess I'm not a very good Muslim, but with all that's happened I would really love to have a copy of the Quran to read.  This seems like a time to get back in touch with God, you know?
dialogue.accepted: Thank you.  I'll see if I can save up a little reward for you.
dialogue.rejected: That's okay.  Thanks for offering.
dialogue.advice: It's not as common as the bible, but you should be able to find copies in most libraries and bookstores, or in religious buildings.  Make sure you get the translated version, I can't read Arabic!
dialogue.success: Thank you so much.  Just having a copy to keep at hand does actually feel pretty comforting.  I did a few extra rounds of chores and saved the proceeds for if you managed this, here you go.  It's not much but I hope it helps.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do me?
dialogue.failure: It's okay.  I don't know how much comfort I'd have found in an old book anyway.

dialogue.describe: Yeah, if you want to risk your neck out there and bring me what I need, I'm not gonna say no.  I can't, like, pay you or anything though, you know that right?
dialogue.offer: Before I get anything going, I'm going to need to set up a compressor.  I have a lot of the stuff for that, but I need a large tank for air, and a good sized electric motor - about 10 kg or so.  I'm also going to need a 60 liter tank, after that.
dialogue.accepted: Great!  Bring it to me when you find one.
dialogue.rejected: Oh well.  Thanks for offering anyway.
dialogue.advice: Try a basic hybrid car, or maybe farm equipment that uses an electric motor.  The kind on a bike would be too small, and the kind on those fance Edison sports cars is going to be too big.
dialogue.inquire: Any sign of a motor I can use?
dialogue.success: That's exactly what I need!  Want to talk about that tank now?  I saved a few merch for you, by the way.
dialogue.success_lie: Huh.  This isn't going to work like I thought.
dialogue.failure: No worries.  Let me know if you want to try again.

dialogue.describe: Now that I've got that motor, I can get my compressor mostly built.  I will need a tank though.
dialogue.offer: I can get started building the compressor, but I need a large metal tank to store compressed air centrally.  About 60 liters should do…
dialogue.accepted: Great!  Bring it to me when you find one.
dialogue.rejected: Oh well.  Thanks for offering anyway.
dialogue.advice: It needs to be a good strong tank, like a big propane tank or something… you could look at fuel storage tanks and things, as long as they're durable enough.  Heck, if you get some sheet metal you could probably even weld a good one together.
dialogue.inquire: Any sign of a tank I can use?
dialogue.success: Hey, this is perfect, "tanks" a bunch.  Okay, I'm sorry for that.  Anyway, now that I've got the parts, I might be able to build a proof of concept.  First I gotta get this thing up and running, and argue with the bean counters about letting me draw power to run it.  Oh right, and here's some merch, thanks for the help!
dialogue.success_lie: Huh.  This isn't going to work like I thought.  Back to the drawing board I guess.
dialogue.failure: No worries.  Let me know if you want to try again.

MISSION_REFUGEE_Uyen_1.name: Find Antiseptic
MISSION_REFUGEE_Uyen_1.description: Find 50 doses of antiseptic for Uyen Tran in the refugee center, in exchange for <reward_count:FMCNote> Merch.

dialogue.offer: There's the doc out front helping anyone that can pay… but for us up here, money mostly goes to food.  I could do a lot for basic cuts, bruises, and common stuff if I had some supplies to help out.  Could you bring me some antiseptic?  Six bottles would probably be enough to last us a while.
dialogue.accepted: Thanks so much.  It's a small thing but it'd be really helpful.
dialogue.rejected: That's okay.  I'm sure we'll make do somehow.
dialogue.advice: Lots of people used to have first aid kits in their bathrooms.  I'm sure they can't all have been looted.
dialogue.success: Thanks so much.  Listen, I told some of the others what you were up to for us and we pooled our cash to thank you.  It's not much but I hope it helps… these are merch, the local money, you can trade them for goods from the shop.  A lot of us will take them in trade too.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

MISSION_REFUGEE_Uyen_2.name: Find Bandages
MISSION_REFUGEE_Uyen_2.description: Find 30 bandages for Uyen Tran in the refugee center, in exchange for <reward_count:FMCNote> Merch.

dialogue.offer: There's the doc out front helping anyone that can pay… but for us up here, money mostly goes to food.  I could do a lot for basic cuts, bruises, and common stuff if I had some supplies to help out.  Could you bring me a few extra bandages?  Thirty would probably be enough to last us a while.
dialogue.accepted: Thanks so much.  It's a small thing but it'd be really helpful.
dialogue.rejected: That's okay.  I'm sure we'll make do somehow.
dialogue.advice: Lots of people used to have first aid kits in their bathrooms.  I'm sure they can't all have been looted.
dialogue.success: Thanks so much.  Listen, I told some of the others what you were up to for us and we pooled our cash to thank you.  It's not much but I hope it helps… these are merch, the local money, you can trade them for goods from the shop.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

MISSION_REFUGEE_Uyen_3.name: Find Prozac
MISSION_REFUGEE_Uyen_3.description: Find 6 bottles of Prozac for Uyen Tran in the refugee center, in exchange for <reward_count:FMCNote> Merch.

dialogue.describe: We could still use your help…
dialogue.offer: I probably shouldn't be prescribing things, but there's a ton of people needing help with sleep in here.  If you could get us some antidepressants, Rhyzaea and I can probably make sure they're doled out appropriately without people having to starve to pay for them.  Three month's worth - about 6 bottles - would last us a little while.
dialogue.accepted: Thanks so much.  It's a small thing but it'd be really helpful.
dialogue.rejected: That's okay.  I'm sure we'll make do somehow.
dialogue.advice: Prozac was really common.  You can probably find it in most medicine cabinets and pharmacies.
dialogue.success: Thanks so much.  Listen, I told some of the others what you were up to for us and we pooled our cash to thank you.  You've done a lot to help us out.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

MISSION_REFUGEE_Vanessa_1.name: Make A Haircut Kit
MISSION_REFUGEE_Vanessa_1.description: Make a makeshift haircut kit for Vanessa Toby in the refugee center.

dialogue.describe: If I had some equipment, I could do some hairdresser work here.
dialogue.offer: I didn't think to pack my hairdressing equipment when I was evacuated.  If you could put together a basic hair cutting kit for me, I could do a bit of styling for people around here.  I'll even give you a free haircut for your troubles.
dialogue.accepted: Cool, thanks.  It'll be good to have something useful to do, and to not be staring at so many shaggy slobs.
dialogue.rejected: Whatever, I'll keep twiddling my thumbs then.
dialogue.advice: I don't need too much.  Scissors, a small mirror, a bit of cloth, and some way to keep it all stored clean when I'm not using it, like a leather pouch or something.  I can get the rest of what I need from shelter supplies.
dialogue.success: Well, this is pretty serviceable.  Heck, these scissors are nice enough that I could probably inexplicably make your hair longer or a different color with them.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do me?
dialogue.failure: Seriously?  You failed to find *scissors*?  How do you tie your shoes in the morning?

MISSION_BROKER_1.name: In a Pickle Pt. 2
MISSION_BROKER_1.description: Deliver 50 large three-liter jars in exchange for <reward_count:FMCNote> certified notes.

dialogue.describe: I do have some work for you.
dialogue.offer: You heard right.  When you brought in those canning jars, it got us thinking about expanding our food storage from dehydrated to include cans.  We could use some larger jars though for big stock items.  Can you bring me 50 large three liter jars?  I'll pay you a Certified Note per two.
dialogue.accepted: Thank you.  Once we get a cottage industry set up with some of our inhabitants, I'll be able to start buying these from you and other scavengers in smaller lots.  This should be enough to test out our equipment.
dialogue.rejected: Oh well.  I'll see if I can find another supplier, thanks.
dialogue.advice: Grocery stores, house kitchens, there's plenty of places to look.
dialogue.success: Wow, that's a lot more jars than it sounded on paper.  Thanks.  Here's your payment.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: I wonder where all the jars went…

MISSION_EVAC_SMOKER_GET_CIGARETTES.name: Smokes, let's go.
MISSION_EVAC_SMOKER_GET_CIGARETTES.description: Make a friend at the refugee center by handing over around five packs - 100 cigarettes.

dialogue.describe: Come on man, I just need a smoke.
dialogue.offer: With all that's been going on, it's been more and more difficult to find a smoke.  My stash has been running low for a while now.  Think you could help me out here?  A few packs is all I need.
dialogue.accepted: Thanks, it's great to see someone willing to help a guy out.
dialogue.rejected: Well, I'll find someone else to do it for me.
dialogue.advice: Plenty of smokers in towns.  Gotta be some left over cigs in some of them houses.
dialogue.success: Thanks!  I'll be sure to put in a good word for you around the center.
dialogue.success_lie: OK, then hand it over.
dialogue.failure: Shit happens.

MISSION_FREE_MERCHANTS_EVAC_1.name: Clear Back Bay
MISSION_FREE_MERCHANTS_EVAC_1.description: Clear out the barricaded back area in the refugee center and lay the former leader of the Free Merchants to rest, in exchange for the local currency: Free Merchant certified notes.

dialogue.offer: If you really want to lend a hand we could use your help clearing out the dead in the back bay.  Fearful of going outside during the first days of the Cataclysm we ended up throwing our dead and the zombies we managed to kill in the sealed back bay.  Our promising leader at the time even fell… he turned into something different.  Kill all of them and make sure they won't bother us again.  We can't pay much, besides some of our own internal money which isn't good for that much yet, but it would help us to reclaim the bay.
dialogue.accepted: Please be careful, we don't need any more deaths.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance, we really need to start reclaiming the region.
dialogue.advice: If you can, get a friend or two to help you.
dialogue.inquire: Will they be bothering us any longer?
dialogue.success: Thank you, having that big of a threat close to home was nerve wracking.  Here's some of our local certified notes, we've been paying these to our workers in exchange for supplies.  They're getting some value in the center as a trade item, I'm afraid they're all we have to spare at the moment.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

MISSION_FREE_MERCHANTS_EVAC_2.name: Missing Caravan
MISSION_FREE_MERCHANTS_EVAC_2.description: Investigate the last known location of a disappeared scavenger trading party, and eliminate any bandits or raiders in the vicinity in exchange for <reward_count:FMCNote> certified notes.

dialogue.offer: This is a bit more involved than the last request, we recently lost a scavenger party coming to trade with us and would like you to investigate.  We strongly suspect a raider band or horde caught them off-guard.  I can give you the coordinates of their last radio message but little else.  In either case, deal with the threat so that the scavengers can continue to pass through in relative safety.  The best reward I can offer is a claim to the supplies they were carrying, plus thirty certified notes - that's our own internal money, good for trading and such.
dialogue.accepted: Our community survives on trade, we appreciate it.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance, we really need to start reclaiming the region.
dialogue.advice: If you can, get a friend or two to help you.
dialogue.success: Thank you, the world is a better place without them.  Two of our more skilled individuals accepted the assistance of the Old Guard in setting up an outpost while you were out.  We didn't have many other options, refugees are still streaming in and we don't know what else to do with our limited food supply.  If you get a chance, you should see if they need your assistance in the future…
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

MISSION_FREE_MERCHANTS_EVAC_3.name: Retrieve Prospectus
MISSION_FREE_MERCHANTS_EVAC_3.description: Visit the farming commune and bring the foreman's prospectus back to the refugee center, for <reward_count:FMCNote> certified notes.

dialogue.offer: We recently set out some skilled people to start an outpost, to secure us some food supplies in a safer location.  The new outpost that we've started could use your assistance.  I need you to get the foreman's prospectus before we begin to send additional refugees to the farming commune.  Consult with the foreman to get more detailed tasks.  We've got 50 Certified Notes for you if you can do this for us.
dialogue.accepted: I'm sure the outpost will expand quickly with your assistance.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance, we really need to start reclaiming the region.
dialogue.advice: Just follow your map.
dialogue.success: With this we'll be able to convince others to invest in the commune.  Thank you, here's your money.  We also managed to get a manual crank hooked up to the garage in the back, so feel free to make use of that - you've been a great help to us.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

MISSION_FREE_MERCHANTS_EVAC_4.name: Solar Power
MISSION_FREE_MERCHANTS_EVAC_4.description: Deliver 10 solar panels to help the Free Merchants set up a renewable power grid, in exchange for a handsome reward.

dialogue.offer: We are starting to build new infrastructure here and would like to get a few new electrical systems online… unfortunately our existing system relies on an array of something called RTGs.  Running generators isn't a viable option underground, of course.  We have a big flat roof up top, and if we had a few solar panels we could use them to top up our usage.  We could pay you pretty handsomely to bring us, say, ten solar panels?
dialogue.accepted: If you can do this for us our survival options would vastly increase.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance, we really need to start reclaiming the region.
dialogue.advice: Solar panels are pretty common on electric cars and on rooftops.
dialogue.success: Great, I know it isn't much but we hope to continue to expand thanks to your help.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

MISSION_FREE_MERCHANTS_EVAC_5.name: In a Pickle
MISSION_FREE_MERCHANTS_EVAC_5.description: Deliver twenty-five half-liter glass canning jars to the Free Merchants to kickstart their food storage plans.

dialogue.offer: While we've managed to secure day to day food supplies, it's very much hand to mouth.  Our reserves would barely last a few days if something kept our people locked in.  We need a stockpile to avoid that.  Thanks to our outpost we have a bit of meat and vegetables coming in, but we need a better way to preserve them.  Some of our people know enough about food canning that if we had a good stock of canning jars, we could make pickles and canned meats to get us set for the winter.  I'll pay you a premium rate if you can bring us twenty-five glass jars to get us started.
dialogue.accepted: It'll take a load off my shoulders if I can finally stop worrying about this.
dialogue.rejected: We'll hold for the moment, but I'll get an ulcer if I have to keep worrying.  If you reconsider let me know.
dialogue.advice: Grocery stores, house kitchens, there's plenty of places to look.
dialogue.success: That's one less thing to worry about.  Glad to have someone like you on our side.  Here's 250 merch, and the broker will buy any further glass jars you can find - at a reduced price, we can't keep up the premium rate.  Actually, the broker was saying they had some jobs like this for you, and that it might be easier to just go straight through their office if you want more work.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

MISSION_FREE_MERCHANTS_HUB_DELIVERY_1.name: Unknown Recipient
MISSION_FREE_MERCHANTS_HUB_DELIVERY_1.description: Deliver the hdd to the military remnant.  Return to the Evacuation Center when the trade is complete.

dialogue.inquire: Have you finished the delivery already?
dialogue.success: Good, that's one less thing to worry about.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: At least you came back with your life…

MISSION_SCIENCE_REP_1.name: Find a Microcentrifuge
MISSION_SCIENCE_REP_1.description: Find a <color_light_blue>microcentrifuge</color>. The doctor knows of a <color_red>medical supply drop</color> where one could likely be found.

dialogue.describe: It could be very informative to perform an analysis of zombie blood…
dialogue.offer: We don't have the equipment for real analysis here so I'll need you to get some.  Critically, I'm missing a microcentrifuge with which I could perform an analysis of zombie blood.  I need you to procure a microcentrifuge and bring it to me.
dialogue.accepted: Excellent.  I happen to know of the location of a nearby supply drop of medical equipment, which likely contains a microcentrifuge.  Otherwise, you should try your luck at research locations.
dialogue.rejected: Are you sure?  The scientific value of that blood data could be priceless…
dialogue.advice: The supply drop should be unguarded, but watch your back.
dialogue.inquire: Well, do you have the microcentrifuge yet?
dialogue.success: Excellent!  This may be the key to removing the infection.  I don't have much to spare, but take this as thanks.
dialogue.success_lie: Wait, this isn't a centrifuge!  Liar!
dialogue.failure: What a shame, that equipment could have proved invaluable…

MISSION_SCIENCE_REP_2.name: Download Workstation Data
MISSION_SCIENCE_REP_2.description: Find a <color_light_blue>workstation console</color> on the first basement floor of the <color_red>science lab</color> and download its data onto a USB drive.

dialogue.offer: Thanks to the microcentrifuge you found, I was able to perform an analysis of zombie blood.  It seems to contain an exotic substance that I am unfortunately unable to identify.  We are not yet out of options though.  Right before the start of all of this, I was under orders to immediately drive any valuable samples to the nearest secure laboratory.  I have the destination address.  Go there, get in, find a workstation, and take any data you can on a USB drive.
dialogue.accepted: Great!  I've mapped out a route to the address.  Most workstations should be on the first basement floor.
dialogue.rejected: Can't blame you, but come back if you change your mind.
dialogue.advice: These labs are usually locked, you may want to try and buy an acetylene torch from the merchant across from me.  Otherwise, there is a high likelihood you could find a science ID on deceased scientists.  Also, make sure you practice your computer skills before you attempt to hack the workstations, they can have dangerous anti-intruder systems.
dialogue.success: Thanks!  This data looks damaged, but maybe I can make something out of it. Also, since you've proven to be capable, I want to give you this equipment. The Old Guard issued it to me when they dropped by with the representative a while ago, but I'm not much of a fighter. I'm sure you could put it to good use though.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

MISSION_SCIENCE_REP_3.name: Download Research Archives
MISSION_SCIENCE_REP_3.description: Find a <color_light_blue>storage archive console</color> on the fourth basement floor of the <color_red>cold science lab</color> and download its data onto a USB drive.

dialogue.offer: So there looks to be months, maybe years of experiments, and that data set must be huge.  Database servers massive enough to house it would overheat running on emergency power.  But I did find communications from a lab that had some kind of freezing portal open during the Cataclysm, sending everything to subzero temperatures.  I bet the archives inside that lab are still working.
dialogue.accepted: Great!  I've mapped out a route.  Bundle up, it gets colder the deeper you go and it looks like the archives were on the fourth basement level.
dialogue.rejected: Can't blame you, but come back if you change your mind.
dialogue.advice: That lab is going to start freezing and just get colder the deeper you go.  You'll really need special equipment to survive that far down.  Bring back anything you find on a USB drive.
dialogue.success: Thanks!  This is a lot of data to go through.  Take this clothing as compensation, it should be helpful if you ever need to go into one of those labs again.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

MISSION_SCIENCE_REP_4.name: Obtain Train Network Information
MISSION_SCIENCE_REP_4.description: Find the <color_light_blue>foreman</color> in the <color_red>microlab</color> and obtain info about the train network.

dialogue.offer: In the data we found a major contract for tunneling and train equipment, ordered a long time ago.  It's the best lead we have.  If these records are correct, it seems this equipment was used to build fully underground 'microlabs' where less hazardous research was carried out.  Luckily, I've identified a microlab that was only just finished before the Cataclysm, enough so that the construction foreman was likely still present.  If anyone carried information about the train networks, it's him.  I want you to go there and retrieve this information.
dialogue.accepted: So glad for your help.
dialogue.rejected: Can't blame you, but come back if you change your mind.
dialogue.advice: I would recommend finding a subway station or other form of underground access and then navigating along the subway lines until you reach the lab.  Keep in mind that less hazardous research doesn't mean less hazardous for you.  These microlabs are likely crawling with zombies and automated defenses, and their tight and winding corridors mean you'll have to be extra careful.
dialogue.success: Fantastic!  I should be able to reconstruct what cargo moved between which labs.  I wonder what was really going on down there.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

MISSION_SCIENCE_REP_5.name: Investigate the Logistics Center
MISSION_SCIENCE_REP_5.description: Find and obtain the <color_light_blue>classified lab reports</color> in the <color_red>trans-coast logistics center</color>.

dialogue.offer: The train network information revealed a completely separate secret train network deeper than the normal subway system that seems to be used exclusively for transport between labs.  Not only that, but it also revealed a network of logistics centers.  You know those trans-coast logistics centers, the big warehouses from the company that promised you same-day shipping?  It turns out those are actually fronts used to facilitate the mass shipment of supplies and the conduction of classified research!  If any place holds the key to unlocking the mystery of how and why this all happened, it is almost certainly locked within one of those centers!  I've identified the center that seems to have been the most critical for the region, and I need you to travel to it and find any information that points you to what could possibly have caused all of this!
dialogue.accepted: So glad for your help.
dialogue.rejected: Can't blame you, but come back if you change your mind.
dialogue.advice: This may be the most dangerous lab you've visited yet.  If I recall correctly, the main entrance is heavily defended by rifle caliber turrets and robots, not to mention the swarms of zombies and other abominations you'll likely find inside.  An intelligent course of action may be to find an entrance to this secret train network, likely located in a lab or microlab at a depth equivalent to the fourth basement floor, and navigate to the logistics center along it.
dialogue.success: Fantastic!  This is exactly the data I needed, and I have a feeling that we will soon uncover a way to finally halt this Cataclysm...
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

MISSION_TCL_CLEANUP_1.name: Eliminate the Shadowy Threat
MISSION_TCL_CLEANUP_1.description: Find and kill the <color_light_blue>shadowy threat</color>. According to the head scientist, it is likely in the <color_red>security wing</color>.

dialogue.describe: We need help to get rid of this threat…
dialogue.offer: Ever since the day we were attacked during the evacuation, we have had to operate in fear of whatever it was that attacked us.  The shadowy figures who did it seem to have mostly left the premises since, but every so often we will spot one during a scavenging run and thus be forced to mount a hasty retreat.  Unluckily, the figure seems to be most present in the lab's security zone, where the armories are.  If you will help us by terminating the threat, I will be willing to give you a copy of the information you seek.
dialogue.accepted: Excellent.  Here is the location of the lab's security zone, along with the floor we last encountered the figure on.  This facility is heavily secured with ID scanners, you will find these IDs useful for navigating this facility, and more can be easily found if you run out.  I wish you good luck, for all our sakes.
dialogue.rejected: Very well, but do not expect to receive the information you seek…
dialogue.advice: I have so far been unable to ascertain the nature of this threat, whether it be mutant, zombie, or even human.  All that is known is that it is a fast and deadly fighter that possesses a field of shadow capable of snuffing out even the brightest lights, as well as incredible durability, effortlessly ignoring small caliber weapons and being barely fazed by a full-auto M4 burst.  Even night vision seems to be unable to spot it within its darkness, but infrared might be able to.
dialogue.success: This is brilliant news indeed!  You have earned my trust and my admiration.  Please take the information with my thanks.  Furthermore, with the threat removed, we can become more bold with our scavenging, and can perhaps even sell you some surplus equipment we find!
dialogue.success_lie: A likely story...
dialogue.failure: It was hopeless anyways...

MISSION_ARSONIST_1_AMMONIUM_NITRATE.name: Supply the arsonist.
MISSION_ARSONIST_1_AMMONIUM_NITRATE.description: Bring the arsonist 42 kg of commercial fertilizer

dialogue.describe: I could use some help getting some materials.
dialogue.offer: I could use some help getting some materials.  Molotovs are nice for burning down buildings but aren't all that for keeping yourself safe.  If you could get me two bags of commercial fertilizer I could make something a lot more potent.
dialogue.accepted: Oh man, thanks so much friend.  You won't regret it.
dialogue.rejected: Think it over.
dialogue.advice: Commercial fertilizer tends to be made from ammonium nitrate, which is also usable as an explosive.  Try looking for some around the abandoned farms.
dialogue.inquire: Did you find any fertilizer?  Are you sure this is the ammonium nitrate kind?
dialogue.success: This is great!  I'll get to work making something of this.  You can have some of my Molotovs, I won't need quite so many now.
dialogue.success_lie: I guess I could convince the shelter to sell me some.
dialogue.failure: Damn.  Perhaps I wasn't the only one who thought of this.

MISSION_EXTERMINATOR_1.name: Kill the Acidic Wasp Queen
MISSION_EXTERMINATOR_1.description: Kill the <color_red>giant acidic wasp queen</color> to prevent the possible spread of <color_red>giant acidic wasps</color>.

dialogue.offer: When I was out on the hunt earlier, I found something disturbing.  A typical giant wasp nest, except the queen seems to have started mutating acidic powers.  I had to get out of there quickly, my beesuit isn't built to handle acid, but we need to nip this in the bud.  Imagine the horror if these acid wasps became widespread.
dialogue.accepted: Good luck.
dialogue.rejected: Just imagine if that thing managed to spread!
dialogue.advice: Whatever armor you decide to wear, make sure it's very resistant to acid, and make sure you can repair it...
dialogue.success: You don't know how much you've done for all of us.  Here, this suit should be useful for any other acidic critters.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

MISSION_OLD_GUARD_REP_1.name: Kill Bandits
MISSION_OLD_GUARD_REP_1.description: A pair of bandits have been preying on locals, based out of a nearby cabin.  Ensure they meet a bitter end along with any associates, but watch out for traps around their hideout.

dialogue.offer: I don't like sending untested men into the field but if you have stayed alive so far you might have some skills.  There are at least a pair of bandits squatting in a local cabin, anyone who preys upon civilians meets a quick end… execute both of them for their crimes.  Complete this and the Old Guard will consider you an asset in the region.
dialogue.accepted: Contractor, I welcome you aboard.
dialogue.rejected: The States will remain a wasteland unless good men choose to save it.
dialogue.advice: They might suspect you are coming, keep an eye out for traps.
dialogue.success: The Old Guard thanks you for eliminating the criminals.  You won't be forgotten.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

MISSION_OLD_GUARD_REP_2.name: Deal with Informant
MISSION_OLD_GUARD_REP_2.description: The Hell's Raiders bandit group may have an informant working inside the Refugee Center.  Investigate and bring them to justice without arousing any suspicions.

dialogue.offer: This task is going to require a little more persuasive skill.  I believe the Hell's Raiders have an informant here to monitor who comes and goes.  I need you to find out who it is and deal with them without letting anyone else know of my suspicions.  We normally allow the Free Merchants to govern themselves so I would hate to offend them.
dialogue.accepted: Thank you, please keep this discreet.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance, we could use a few good men.
dialogue.advice: If they draw first blood their friends are less likely to blame you…
dialogue.success: Thank you, I'll do the explaining if anyone else asks about it.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

MISSION_OLD_GUARD_REP_3.name: Secure Trade Route
MISSION_OLD_GUARD_REP_3.description: One of the Free Merchants silently disappeared while escorting a trade caravan.  Whoever or whatever is responsible must be quick and quiet - investigate the trade route and eliminate the threat.

dialogue.offer: There is another monster troubling the merchants but this time it isn't human… at least I don't think.  Guy just disappeared while walking behind a packed caravan.  They didn't hear any shots but I suppose some raider may have been real sneaky.  Check out the area and report anything you find.
dialogue.accepted: Thanks, keeping the people safe is what we try and do.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance, we really need to start reclaiming the region.
dialogue.advice: Search the bushes for any trace?  I'm not an expert tracker but you should be able to find something.
dialogue.success: Great work, wasn't sure what I was sending you after.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

MISSION_OLD_GUARD_REP_4.name: Assassinate Raider Leader
MISSION_OLD_GUARD_REP_4.description: The Old Guard have located a Hell's Raiders encampment that is coordinating attacks on the Free Merchants.  Pay them a visit and execute the area leadership.

dialogue.offer: I've located a Hell's Raiders encampment in the region that appears to be coordinating operations against the Free Merchants.  We know almost nothing about the command structure in the 'gang' so I need to send someone in to decapitate the leadership.  The raid will be held under orders of the U.S. Marshals Service and by agreeing to the mission you will become a marshal, swearing to assist the federal government in regaining order.
dialogue.accepted: Now repeat after me…  I do solemnly swear that I will support and defend the Constitution of the United States against all enemies, foreign and domestic…… that I will bear true faith and allegiance to the same…… that I take this obligation freely, without any mental reservation or purpose of evasion…… and that I will well and faithfully discharge the duties of the office on which I am about to enter.  To establish justice, insure domestic tranquility, provide for the common defense, promote the general welfare and secure the blessings of liberty.  So help me God.  Congratulations Marshal, don't forget your badge and gun.  As a marshal all men or women assisting you are considered deputy marshals so keep them in line.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance, we could use a few good men.
dialogue.advice: I'd recommend having two deputies… it would be a death trap if a single man got surrounded.
dialogue.inquire: Has the leadership been dealt with?
dialogue.success: Marshal, you continue to impress us.  With their leadership broken it will be easier to establish a foothold in the area, secure resources for rebuilding.  I've been keeping Command informed and while there is certainly a lot you could do to help here, they might have missions for me to offer you that will take you farther afield.  In any case, thank you once again marshal.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

MISSION_OLD_GUARD_REP_5.name: Link Up With Vault Expedition
MISSION_OLD_GUARD_REP_5.description: Find the team securing an installation under a city, return with the captain's report on the location.

dialogue.offer: If you are interested, I recently received a message that a unit was deploying into our AO.  I've been informed of an underground facility they're attempting to secure, and they may require assistance.  The bird dropped them off next to a pump station.  Not much more I can tell you.  We've had difficulty keeping in contact with them, so command has requested you give us a status report when you return.  If you could locate the captain in charge, I'm sure he could use your skills.
dialogue.accepted: It's a small urban center with a fortified vault underneath it.  The sewage network most likely contains access tunnels to enter the facility itself, and if they're going to actually get any use out of the place they'll likely focus their efforts on any communications hub or command-and-control systems inside.  We last heard contact from them shortly before they ventured underground, if they are still alive the lack of radio silence means they probably got tied up trying to get comms online.  If you can, get a full sit-rep from their commanding officer.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance, we need someone with experience like you.
dialogue.advice: That place had to have been staffed when this started, so if they had to try and re-take it you should expect trouble of some sort.  They last reports also mentioned damage from what might be artillery or some other ordinance, so infrastructure on the surface might be damaged.  Might even be contaminated, the conditions are currently an unknown at present.
dialogue.inquire: What do you have for me?
dialogue.success: Great, I'll work on sending word to my superiors about this.  I'm going to guess it was a mess down there, but hopefully their report will tell us more about what's still functional and could be brought back online.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

MISSION_ROBOFAC_INTERCOM_1.name: Return Field Data
MISSION_ROBOFAC_INTERCOM_1.description: Investigate a <color_red>nearby field</color> and return with Dr. Prado and the robot prototype she was testing.  Failing that, retrieve the <color_light_blue>I/O recorder</color> stored within the robot.  If the robot remains operational, avoid direct confrontation and use EMP grenades to disable it.

dialogue.offer: One of our scientists recently left the lab to perform a field test on a prototype robot, but failed to return, and has not been heard of since.  Investigate the test and return with her and the prototype.  Failing that, return with the data recorder that was attached to our prototype.
dialogue.accepted: We appreciate your help, good luck.
dialogue.rejected: Don't expect our help then.
dialogue.advice: If the robot remains operational don’t try to fight it head on, because it WILL kill you.  Dr. Prado left the Hub with a handful of EMP grenades, use those to disable the robot.
dialogue.inquire: Don't you have a job to do?
dialogue.success: Unfortunate only the data was salvageable, but you have our thanks for returning it nonetheless.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: Simply useless…

MISSION_ROBOFAC_INTERCOM_2.name: Steal a Dead Man's Mind
MISSION_ROBOFAC_INTERCOM_2.description: Find the corpse of Hub 01's head AI researcher at the <color_red>ambushed convoy</color>, use the mind splicer kit to recover the memories stored inside their memory implant, and copy them onto the <color_light_blue>data card</color>.

dialogue.offer: When the portal storms started, the Government issued an evacuation order for critical XEDRA personnel and sent convoys to retrieve them, with our head of AI research among the recalled.  We recently discovered that he died when the convoy transferring him was ambushed in the initial chaos, but his corpse and memory bionic might remain intact enough for us to extract valuable knowledge.  We want you to travel to the location, make a copy of his Bionic Memory Unit, and return it to us.
dialogue.accepted: Remember, perform the extraction /exactly/ as specified, otherwise the bionic will self-destruct.
dialogue.rejected: Yes, we recognize that our request is exceptional.  Return if you change your mind.
dialogue.advice: You do know what a memory unit looks like, right?  Matte gray, pill-sized, right in front of the corpus callosum.  We suggest a forceps through the eye socket, shaking slightly, then slowly and carefully…
dialogue.success: You have our thanks and payment.  We will need the mind splicer back though.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: Simply useless…

MISSION_ROBOFAC_INTERCOM_3.name: Light Retrieval
MISSION_ROBOFAC_INTERCOM_3.description: Reach the <color_red>collapsed tower basement</color>, and search the ruins for a <color_light_blue>photonic circuitry template</color>.  The intercom warned you about heavy enemy presence, and of the existence of a hazardous environment.

dialogue.offer: Our facility once sourced advanced photonic circuitry from a nearby robotics manufacturer.  Their building suffered major damage during the portal storms, and collapsed almost entirely.  However, preliminary scouting reveals that the basement prototyping lab likely remains intact.  We ask you to investigate the ruins, and if possible, retrieve a template for the fabrication of said photonic circuitry.
dialogue.accepted: We expect your success, mercenary.
dialogue.rejected: Return if you change your mind.
dialogue.advice: The scout drone also revealed extensive heat signatures and high concentrations of toxic compounds within the ruins, plan accordingly.  We are willing to sell you some protective gear at a discount, if you require it.
dialogue.success: Fantastic.  You have our thanks and payment.  The elevator access doors have been opened, and you are now authorized to use the elevator.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: Simply useless…

MISSION_ROBOFAC_INTERCOM_4.name: Bury the Light
MISSION_ROBOFAC_INTERCOM_4.description: Reach the <color_red>physics lab</color> and retrieve the document <color_light_blue>PROCEDURE 025-EPSILON</color>.

dialogue.offer: We have identified the location of an underground classified research facility that our records indicate was dedicated to the study of 'advanced physics'.  We need you to investigate this facility and retrieve a critical document that is likely located inside, titled 'PROCEDURE 025-EPSILON'.
dialogue.accepted: We await results, mercenary.
dialogue.rejected: Return if you change your mind.
dialogue.advice: The lab itself should be similar in format to a standard microlab, and thus is likely only accessible through the subway system.  We have no information as to what could be inside this facility.
dialogue.success: Fascinating.  It is possible the portal storms caused a sort of synergy with the anomaly, causing its effects to expand greatly during the initial days of the Cataclysm.  This would align with the development of...
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: Simply useless…

dialogue.describe: I could do with some help…
dialogue.offer: I'm still supposed to scavenge for gold, I can offer you the same deal as last time.
dialogue.accepted: Wonderful.
dialogue.rejected: Well I'll look for the gold myself.
dialogue.advice: Try searching banks and security vans.
dialogue.success: I appreciate it, here's your pay.
dialogue.success_lie: Yeah, sure.
dialogue.failure: Well I'll have to scavenge the gold myself, thanks for nothing.

MISSION_ROBOFAC_MERC_1_RADIO.name: Active Noise Control
MISSION_ROBOFAC_MERC_1_RADIO.description: Investigate Hub 01's radio tower, discover the source of the interference, and fix the problem.

dialogue.offer: A few days ago, I installed a radio transmitter in the nearby tower, but it stopped working recently.  If you are willing to be my back up while I check it out, I'll owe you a favor.
dialogue.accepted: Alright, lets be off.  You don't mind taking point, right?
dialogue.rejected: Well thanks for offering, I guess.
dialogue.advice: I'm sure we'll figure it out once there.  In any case, make sure to shoot first.
dialogue.inquire: You think we killed the culprit?
dialogue.success: Sure seems like it.  Lets go back to the hub.
dialogue.success_lie: Sure, thanks for nothing.
dialogue.failure: Simply useless…

dialogue.offer: Lets go back to the Hub
dialogue.accepted: Alright, lets be off.  You don't mind taking point, right?
dialogue.rejected: Well…
dialogue.advice: You keep a map around don't you?  I do, and you probably should too.
dialogue.success: Thanks for having my back.  As I said, I owe you one.
dialogue.success_lie: Are you lost or something?
dialogue.failure: Can't believe we got lost…

MISSION_SCRAP_TRADER_GET_5_MICROWAVE.name: Find 5 Microwaves
MISSION_SCRAP_TRADER_GET_5_MICROWAVE.description: Obtain 5 microwaves in exchange for credit with the scrap merchant.

dialogue.offer: Since business is increasing around here, I've decided to start selling more specialized metal.  Problem is, I can't separate the metal out.  Fortunately, I found some old schematics on a machine for this sort of thing.  If you could get me 5 microwaves, I can melt down the sorted stuff into bars.  I can quickly pay you in raw materials.
dialogue.advice: Microwaves were found in almost every home.  An apartment block should have tons of them.
dialogue.accepted: I'll be here when you get back.  Good luck!
dialogue.rejected: Someone's got to do it.
dialogue.success: Wonderful!  I'll start the smelting as soon as possible.
dialogue.success_lie: Where are they?  I don't believe you.
dialogue.failure: That's unfortunate.  I guess I'll do it myself.

MISSION_SCRAP_TRADER_GET_75_CHARCOAL.name: Obtain 75 Charcoal
MISSION_SCRAP_TRADER_GET_75_CHARCOAL.description: Obtain 75 lumps of charcoal in exchange for credit with the scrap merchant.

dialogue.offer: That machine I put together is working wonderfully, but the generator is nearly out of juice.  If you could get me 75 lumps of charcoal, I'll pay you however I can.
dialogue.advice: Its fairly simple to make some.  I don't know where you could find any, though.
dialogue.accepted: I'll be here when you get back.  Good luck!
dialogue.rejected: Someone's got to do it.
dialogue.success: Wonderful!  This should do for a while.
dialogue.success_lie: Where are they?  I don't believe you.
dialogue.failure: That's unfortunate.  I guess I'll do it myself.

MISSION_SCRAP_TRADER_GET_100_SOLDER.name: Obtain 100 Solder
MISSION_SCRAP_TRADER_GET_100_SOLDER.description: Obtain 100 solder in exchange for credit with the scrap merchant.

dialogue.offer: That machine I put together needs some repairs on it, but I'm out of soldering wire.  If you could get me about 100 spools, I'll pay you for it.
dialogue.advice: An electronics store might have some.
dialogue.accepted: I'll be here when you get back.  Good luck!
dialogue.rejected: Someone's got to do it.
dialogue.success: Wonderful!  This should do for a while.
dialogue.success_lie: Where are they?  I don't believe you.
dialogue.failure: That's unfortunate.  I guess I'll do it myself.

MISSION_SCRAPPER_SET_TRADE_ROUTE.name: Establish A Trade Route
MISSION_SCRAPPER_SET_TRADE_ROUTE.description: Establish trade relations between the scrapper and a refugee center, and bring back a writ of the agreement.

dialogue.offer: I was out scavenging recently, and I found one of those old evac shelters.  Turns out the computer was still on and had an address for a refugee center.  I figure they might want some spare metal, so I need you to go over there and strike a deal with them.
dialogue.advice: It should be pretty simple making the deal, but I'd recommend taking a car over there myself.
dialogue.accepted: I'll be here when you get back.  Good luck!
dialogue.rejected: Please?  This is really important to me.
dialogue.inquire: What did they say about it?
dialogue.success: Thank you!
dialogue.success_lie: How does this help us?
dialogue.failure: That's unfortunate.  I guess we'll have to find someone else to trade with.

dialogue.offer: The wine and beer we can brew are sufficient to attract most patrons but we need something a bit stronger to get them to forget their misery.  Could you build me a pair of stills?
dialogue.accepted: This should let us start producing whiskey, rum, and brandy when we get access to the ingredients.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance.  We need skilled survivors.
dialogue.advice: I'm sure you could find the design for the stills in home brewing books.
dialogue.success: Thank you for the delivery.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.offer: The last batch that I brewed was terrible, I'm fairly sure something contaminated the yeast we have been using.  Could you locate a source of fresh yeast for us to use?  I'd need about 20 teaspoons of dry yeast to get started.
dialogue.accepted: Thank you for your assistance.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance.  We need skilled survivors.
dialogue.advice: Yeast should be common in homes or bakeries.
dialogue.success: Thank you for the delivery.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.offer: Sugar and molasses remains in short supply.  I've put in a request for more but it is unlikely that I'm going to see a reliable source for some time.  If you are interested, we are going to need sugar beet seeds to meet future demand regardless of what the scavengers can find.  Could you bring me at least enough seeds to plant a small 10 meter long patch?
dialogue.accepted: Thank you for your assistance.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance.  We need skilled survivors.
dialogue.advice: Farms or supply stores might have a few seeds…
dialogue.inquire: Do you have the sugar beet seeds?
dialogue.success: Thank you for the delivery.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.offer: The drinks we brew here have become a major draw for visitors and the occasional trader.  Our batches have become larger but we are still running out of storage space between trading runs.  I've been able to get a few volunteers to help me build a set of standing tanks but I still need 12 metal tanks to build them.  I've talked with the scrappers but we are a low priority at the moment.
dialogue.accepted: Thank you for your assistance.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance.  We need skilled survivors.
dialogue.advice: Scrapping vehicles might be your best bet.
dialogue.inquire: Do you have the metal tanks?
dialogue.success: Thank you for the delivery.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.offer: The other survivor outposts that we have contact with have been more than eager to trade for beer or other drinks.  Transporting the drinks to them has presented a number of challenges though.  If you could locate a pair of 200-liter drums we should be able to keep them supplied while turning a significant profit.
dialogue.accepted: Thank you for your assistance.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance.  We need skilled survivors.
dialogue.advice: Factories or junk yards are the only places I know where to look.
dialogue.success: Thank you for the delivery.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.offer: Our first project is to enclose the barn so that new refugees have a safe place to sleep.  Before we can begin serious improvements we need lumber to work with.  Enclosing the four barn entrances will take nearly 400 planks… if you could provide half of that we should be able to take care of the other half and construction.  If you don't have a truck, I'd make finding one your first priority.
dialogue.accepted: The more men we can bring to the camp the quicker improvements can be made.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance.  We need skilled survivors.
dialogue.advice: Avoid destroying the furniture, we'll be needing it.
dialogue.success: Great, I'll send word that we could use another set of hands or two to help out here.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.offer: With the barn entrances enclosed the refugees moving into there should feel safer but the weather can be bitter here.  We're going to need to build makeshift beds in the stalls to ward off disease and frostbite.  We can take care of the frames but will need your help looting blankets.  We'd need 25 blankets to provide the most basic sleeping accommodations.
dialogue.accepted: I'd start with looting hotels or you could sew them together… but that would be a last resort.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance.  We need skilled survivors.
dialogue.advice: Avoid destroying the furniture here, we'll be needing it.
dialogue.success: Your assistance is always appreciated.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.offer: Our supply of nails has been depleted.  I'm going to have to ask you to get us a few more boxes.  Hardware stores should have a few if they haven't been looted.  I suppose you may be able to find handfuls of them in building rubble.  We'd need 2500 to have enough that we won't be sending you back out too soon.
dialogue.accepted: Deconstructing furniture isn't going to be efficient, try looking for boxes or grabbing any sitting on top of rubble piles.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance.  We need skilled survivors.
dialogue.advice: Avoid destroying the furniture here, we'll be needing it.
dialogue.success: Your assistance is always appreciated.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.offer: I'm sure you've noticed the new workers that have started trickling in.  The Free Merchant counsel is demanding that we immediately begin projects to become self-sufficient due to limited supplies.  We are going to need to rapidly setup an agricultural industry before winter and starvation catches us unprepared and unsupported.  In order to get a half dozen shovels and a couple of bags of seeds, we are going to have to trade for it.  I've already got the deal lined up but the only thing they are willing to trade it for is salt.  I negotiated them down from 500 units to 300… we were hoping you might have access to a source.
dialogue.accepted: Salt is key to preserving meat and other perishables… without any excess food it wouldn't do us much good now but I imagine we'll need to send you out to get more in the future.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance.  We need skilled survivors.
dialogue.advice: If you can find a source of salt water you should be able to boil it down.
dialogue.success: We are going to begin preparing our fields immediately.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.offer: Well, our first crop will be planted shortly but I'm starting to suspect that our profit margin is going to be much smaller than we expect.  With limited seed for our original crop our next course of action is to increase the soil's fertility.  Is there any way you could find or produce a basic liquid fertilizer for us?  We'd need at least 30 units to make a significant improvement in our output.
dialogue.accepted: I don't know the exact recipe but I'm sure you could make it from a commercial fertilizer or produce it from bonemeal.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance.  We need skilled survivors.
dialogue.advice: I'd look through a few basic chemistry books to find a simple recipe.
dialogue.inquire: Do you have the liquid fertilizer?
dialogue.success: This really should make the first winter easier to survive.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.offer: Our current assessment for survivability has increased significantly thanks to your efforts.  The next priority issue is securing a cleaner water source.  Drinking from the pond on the back end of the ranch has led to an outbreak of dysentery.  As quickly as possible we need to improve the sanitary conditions in the camp.  To do so the first step is to dig a well and construct stone fireplaces in the barn for the migrants to boil water.  We are going to need at least 75 rocks from you if we hope to accomplish the task before we all get sick.  After we have them installed you will have free access to them, guaranteed.
dialogue.accepted: If you take a shovel to a pile of rubble you should be able to pull out structural grade stone.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance.  We need skilled survivors.
dialogue.advice: Mining would always be an option if you had the resources.
dialogue.success: I appreciate the work you do.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.offer: To fabricate the well's hand pump and construct components for several other projects we are going to need to find or fabricate a number of steel pipes.  Plumbing is a distant possibility for now but some form of irrigation will eventually become desirable.  You could assist us with procuring 50 steel pipes, if you so have the chance.
dialogue.accepted: Hopefully we will be able to assign new migrants to help fulfill our needs in the future.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance.  We need skilled survivors.
dialogue.advice: Pipes are used in numerous metal constructions.  Smashing abandoned furniture may provide the material we need.
dialogue.success: I appreciate the work you do.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.offer: With the well's completion we are rapidly closing the sustainability gap.  In order to expand from here we will need massive quantities of lumber to construct fortifications and new buildings.  We have already begun work on a manually operated sawmill but we will need two motors to control the actual blades.  We were hoping you might be able to secure the motors for us.
dialogue.accepted: Power for the motors will be provided by a salvaged truck battery, you need not bring additional mechanical components.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance.  We need skilled survivors.
dialogue.advice: Motors of this kind are pretty commonplace in industrial machinery.
dialogue.success: I appreciate the work you do.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.offer: Disease and infection remains a persistent problem among the refugees.  Without dedicated medical personnel and facilities I doubt everyone will be willing to stick around when the next outbreak happens.  Until we can get a former medic or nurse I'm just going to have to improvise.  Sterilization would be the first step I imagine.  Bring me 5 gallon jugs of bleach so we can get started.
dialogue.accepted: I'm sure you can find bleach in most homes…
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance.  We need skilled survivors.
dialogue.advice: If you can't find a large supply I'd recommend checking hospitals or research labs.
dialogue.success: I appreciate it.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.offer: We've started planning a medical clinic but we are going to need a lot more supplies if we hope to warrant sending one of the few people with medical experience from the refugee center to our outpost.  I know first aid kits are rare but they have all the basic supplies that I'm uncertain of.  If you could bring in 6 full kits I'm sure we could supplement them to make them last a bit longer.
dialogue.accepted: We'll do our best to make them last…
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance.  We need skilled survivors.
dialogue.advice: Homes, hospitals, labs, and doctor offices would be where I'd check.
dialogue.inquire: Do you have the first aid kits?
dialogue.success: I appreciate it.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.offer: The work you have done has swayed the leaders at the refugee center to send someone out to assist with our medical needs.  The next step is for us to get a sort of chop-shop setup so that we can begin using scrap metal to build fortifications and equipment.  We are going to need a pair of arc welders for our mechanics to use.
dialogue.accepted: With two, we should be able to repair one if it breaks.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance.  We need skilled survivors.
dialogue.advice: The only place I've seen them is garages but I imagine you could find them in some stores.
dialogue.success: I appreciate it.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…
